programme.title: A winter’s tale
programme.desc: Disa mijëra vjet më pare, hutët e dimrit ndërtuan një marrëveshje fati me brejtësit e llojit leming. Pothuajse cdo 4 vite, lemingët shtohen në numër shumë të madh. Kështu, hutët e dimrit kanë ushqim të mjaftueshëm për t’i ushqyer të vegjlit e tyre. Hutët mund të shumohen deri në 11 zogjë të vegjël, dhe secili prej tyre ka nevojë për 4 lemingë në ditë. Kohëve të fundit, shumimi i lemingëve në përgjithësi nuk ka qenë aq i rregullt në disa pjesë të Tundra. Çfarë do të ndodh me ta dhe hutët e dimrit?

programme.desc: యువకుడు మంకీ డి లఫ్ఫీ, అతని సముద్రపు దొంగల బృందం ఒక కల్పిత నిధిని కనుగొనడానికి ఉత్తేజకరమైన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

programme.desc: సూపర్‌హీరోలు రాబిన్, సైబోర్గ్, స్టార్‌ఫైర్, రావెన్, బీస్ట్ బాయ్ లోకరక్షకులు యుద్ధం ఆపినవెంటనే సమస్యలు మొదలవుతాయి.

programme.title: టీన్ టైటాన్స్ గో!

programme.title: బయోనిక్ మాక్స్
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: పరిశోధనా కేంద్రం నుండి తప్పించుకుని బయటి ప్రపంచంలో అడుగుపెట్టిన మాక్స్, గోల్డ్ ఫిష్ లు అనేక సాహసాలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: బయోనిక్ మాక్స్
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: పరిశోధనా కేంద్రం నుండి తప్పించుకుని బయటి ప్రపంచంలో అడుగుపెట్టిన మాక్స్, గోల్డ్ ఫిష్ లు అనేక సాహసాలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: హంటర్ X హంటర్
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: గాన్ ఫ్రీక్స్, అదృశ్యమైన తన తండ్రిని వెతకాలనే ఆశతో, అరుదైన రాక్షసులు, నిధిని వేటాడే హంటర్‌గా మారడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: వన్ పీస్
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: యువకుడు మంకీ డి లఫ్ఫీ, అతని సముద్రపు దొంగల బృందం ఒక కల్పిత నిధిని కనుగొనడానికి ఉత్తేజకరమైన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: కిటెరెట్సు
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: ప్రాథమిక పాఠశాల విద్యార్థి కిటెరెట్సు, అతని రోబోట్ కొరోసుకే తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి వివిధ సాహసాలలో పాల్గొంటారు.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: వీ బేర్ బేర్స్
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్లీ, పాండా, ఐస్ లు ఆధునిక మానవ జీవితాన్ని గడిపే క్రమంలో శాన్ ఫ్రాన్సిస్కో బే ఏరియాలో ఇబ్బందులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: లూనీ ట్యూన్స్ కార్టూన్స్
programme.sub-title: Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Sylvester, Tweety, Road Runner and many others go through a series of funny misadventures
programme.desc: బగ్స్ బన్నీ, డాఫీ డక్, పోర్కీ పిగ్, ట్వీటీ, రోడ్ రన్నర్, ఇతర పాత్రలు వరుస హాస్యాస్పదమైన సాహసాలను ఎదుర్కొంటాయి.

credits.actor: Eric Bauza (Bugs Bunny/Daffy Duck/Marvin the Martian/Tweety),Jeff Bergman (Elmer Fudd/Sylvester/Ralph Wolf),Bob Bergen (Porky Pig),Fred Tatasciore (Yosemite Sam/Gossamer/Sam Sheepdog),Candi Milo (Granny),Michael Ruocco (Beaky Buzzard)

programme.sub-title: Weasy, an opportunistic weasel with a penchant for burglary, finds himself incubating a large egg, which leads to significant changes in his life

programme.desc: పరిశోధనా కేంద్రం నుండి తప్పించుకుని బయటి ప్రపంచంలో అడుగుపెట్టిన మాక్స్, గోల్డ్ ఫిష్ లు అనేక సాహసాలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: హంటర్ X హంటర్
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: గాన్ ఫ్రీక్స్, అదృశ్యమైన తన తండ్రిని వెతకాలనే ఆశతో, అరుదైన రాక్షసులు, నిధిని వేటాడే హంటర్‌గా మారడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: వన్ పీస్
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: యువకుడు మంకీ డి లఫ్ఫీ, అతని సముద్రపు దొంగల బృందం ఒక కల్పిత నిధిని కనుగొనడానికి ఉత్తేజకరమైన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: కిటెరెట్సు
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: ప్రాథమిక పాఠశాల విద్యార్థి కిటెరెట్సు, అతని రోబోట్ కొరోసుకే తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి వివిధ సాహసాలలో పాల్గొంటారు.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: వీ బేర్ బేర్స్
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్లీ, పాండా, ఐస్ లు ఆధునిక మానవ జీవితాన్ని గడిపే క్రమంలో శాన్ ఫ్రాన్సిస్కో బే ఏరియాలో ఇబ్బందులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: Hot Life Africa
programme.sub-title: Many species that live in extreme places slow down their cycles of reproduction and breeding. Wild dogs speed up the process by several weeks to avoid having to expose their pups to the dangers of heat
programme.desc: The threat of climate change is especially a risk for those living in the world's hottest regions, such as the Namib, the Kalahari and the Kaokoveld in the southern cone of Africa.

programme.title: Surviving Earth
programme.sub-title: A matriarch elephant leads her herd on a journey to find water, encountering an alien continent where they must adapt to a new way of life to survive
programme.desc: An eight-part docuseries exploring Earth's major eras and extinction events across 450 million years alongside the creatures who fought to survive.

programme.title: Gangs of Baboon Falls
programme.sub-title: As lockdown continues, the streets of Victoria Falls have become eerily deserted, and the gangs must now figure out new ways to survive in a dramatically changed world
programme.desc: Four competing troops of chacma baboons squabble over food and battle for territorial supremacy around the stunning setting of Victoria Falls, on the border of Zimbabwe and Zambia.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals.

programme.desc: स्कल आईलैंड का नक्शा बनाने के लिए वहां पहुंचने वाले एक दल पर विशालकाय बंदर ने हमला कर दिया। बचे हुए लोग बंदर, द्वीप के मूल निवासियों और भूमिगत राक्षसों के बारे में अधिक जानने के लिए इकट्ठा होते हैं।.

credits.actor: Tom Hiddleston (James Conrad),Samuel L. Jackson (Preston Packard),Brie Larson (Mason Weaver),John C. Reilly (Hank Marlow),John Goodman (Bill Randa),Corey Hawkins (Houston Brooks),John Ortiz (Victor Nieves),Jing Tian (San),Toby Kebbell (Jack Chapman/Kong Mo-Cap Services),Jason Mitchell (Mills),Shea Whigham (Cole),Thomas Mann (Slivko),Eugene Cordero (Reles),Marc Evan Jackson (Landsat Steve),Will Brittain (Young Marlow/Marlow's Son),Miyavi (Gunpei Ikari),Richard Jenkins (Senator Willis),Allyn Rachel (Secretary O'Brien),Robert Taylor (Athena Captain),Terry Notary (Kong Mo-Cap Services)

programme.title: गॉडज़िला x कोंग: द न्यू एम्पायर
programme.sub-title: Godzilla and Kong, two titans from the ancient world, join forces to face a colossal threat emerging from deep within the earth's core
programme.desc: प्राचीन दुनिया के दो दिग्गज, गॉडज़िला और कॉन्ग, पृथ्वी की गहराई से उभर रहे एक विशाल खतरे का सामना करने के लिए एकजुट होते हैं।.

credits.actor: Rebecca Hall (Ilene Andrews),Brian Tyree Henry (Bernie Hayes),Dan Stevens (Trapper),Kaylee Hottle (Jia),Alex Ferns (Mikael),Fala Chen (Iwi Queen),Rachel House (Hampton),Ron Smyck (Harris),Chantelle Jamieson (Jayne),Greg Hatton (Lewis),Kevin Copeland (Submarine Commander),Tess Dobré (Submarine Officer),Tim Carroll (Wilcox),Anthony Brandon Wong (Talk Show Anchor)

programme.title: जाने तू या जाने ना
programme.sub-title: Inseparable companions completely reject a romantic bond despite their flawless compatibility. However, subsequent dating loops reveal that they actually share deep, unspoken love
programme.desc: बेहतरीन तालमेल होने के बावजूद, अटूट साथी रोमांटिक रिश्ते को पूरी तरह से नकार देते हैं। हालाँकि, बाद में डेटिंग के दौरान पता चलता है कि असल में उनके बीच गहरा और बिना कहे बयां होने वाला प्यार है।.

credits.actor: Imran Khan,Genelia D'Souza,Naseeruddin Shah,Arbaaz Khan,Sohail Khan,Ratna Pathak

programme.title: टर्बो
programme.sub-title: Jose, a jeep driver, steps into a complex situation with his friend and a corrupt scheme. However, he helps uncover the truth, stands up to threats and seeks justice for his friend
programme.desc: जोस, एक जीप चालक, अपने दोस्त और एक भ्रष्ट योजना के साथ एक जटिल स्थिति में कदम रखता है। हालांकि, वह सच्चाई को उजागर करने में मदद करते हुए धमकियों का सामना करता है और अपने दोस्त के लिए न्याय मांगता है।.

credits.actor: Mammootty,Raj B. Shetty,Sunil,Anjana Jayaprakash,Kabir Duhan Singh,Shabareesh Varma,Alexander Prasanth,Johny Antony,Niranjana Anoop

programme.title: क्राइम पैट्रोल
programme.sub-title: The host presents dramatised re-enactments of real-life crime cases that revolve around harassment, kidnapping and murder
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता, उत्पीड़न, अपहरण और हत्या पर आधारित वास्तविक जीवन के आपराधिक मामलों का नाटकीय रूपांतरण प्रस्तुत करते हैं।.

programme.title: क्राइम पेट्रोल: 48 घंटे
programme.sub-title: A burglary is reported at the house of an aged couple. However, a subsequent police investigation uncovers rampant family conflicts and the presence of a mysterious girl in the house
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता अपराध के मामलों का नाटकीय रूप से मंचन करते हैं तथा पुलिस विभाग द्वारा 48 घंटों के भीतर मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए किए गए सतर्क प्रयासों को दर्शाते हैं।.

programme.title: बेस्ट ऑफ़ क्राइम पेट्रोल
programme.sub-title: Some of the best cases of 'Crime Patrol', which investigates how innocent people turn into criminals due to the influence of evil in society
programme.desc: कार्यक्रम, 'क्राइम पेट्रोल' में हत्या, अपहरण, धोखाधड़ी और चोरी जैसे कई अपराधों से जुड़ी सच्ची कहानियों को नाट्य रूपांतरण के माध्यम से पेश किया जाता है।.

programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.desc: एक पाक विशेषज्ञ विभिन्न पाककला युक्तियां और मुंह में पानी लाने वाले व्यंजनों की चरण-दर-चरण विधियां सरल और समझने में आसान तरीके से साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: एपिपीडिया
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on the lesser-known facts about the country of India through voyages that have enabled the documentation of the evolution of India
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता भारत के विकास को दिखाने के लिए, यात्राओं के माध्यम से भारत देश के ऐसे तथ्यों के बारे में बताते हैं जो पूर्णता ज्ञात नहीं है।.

programme.title: त्यौहार की थाली
programme.sub-title: The host shares cherished festive recipes, including heirloom dishes, while celebrating the country's culture by exploring its rich folklore
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता देश की समृद्ध लोककथाओं का अन्वेषण करके देश की संस्कृति का जश्न मनाते हुए, पारंपरिक व्यंजनों सहित पसंदीदा त्योहारी रेसिपी साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: इतिहास की थाली से
programme.sub-title: The host displays 'murabba,' a juicy jam made from seasonal fruits, and explains how the sweet arrived in India
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता कुछ रोचक तथ्यों के साथ, विभिन्न व्यंजनों के समृद्ध इतिहास पर प्रकाश डालते हैं जो किसी के सांसारिक जीवन को रोचक बना देते हैं।.

programme.title: इंडिपीडिया
programme.sub-title: Edward sets out to learn about the various religious talismans that are usually found hanging on the doors of Indian households
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता भारत के विभिन्न राज्यों की यात्रा करते हैं और उन रीति-रिवाजों और परंपराओं के बारे में अधिक जानकारी प्राप्त करते हैं जो प्राचीन काल से देश का हिस्सा रहे हैं।.

programme.title: एकांत
programme.sub-title: The host explores abandoned historical spots in India that are filled with mystery and studies how these once-flourishing places came to be in ruins
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता भारत में अनेक ऐतिहासिक दृष्टि से महत्वपूर्ण स्थलों की यात्रा करते हैं तथा उनके परित्याग के कारणों की पड़ताल करते हैं।.

programme.title: इटरनल बिहार
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on the rich heritage of Bihar by exploring its magnificent architecture and historical landmarks
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता बिहार की भव्य वास्तुकला और ऐतिहासिक स्थलों की खोज करके इसकी समृद्ध विरासत पर प्रकाश डालते हैं।.

programme.title: रक्त
programme.sub-title: The third Mughal ruler Akbar was renowned as the greatest across the history of India and under his administration the economy thrived
programme.desc: विशेषज्ञ राजाओं द्वारा राज्यों पर अधिकार करने के लिए किए गए कुछ प्रमुख युद्धों और हत्याओं पर विस्तार से चर्चा करते हैं, जिन्होंने आधुनिक भारत की दिशा को आकार दिया।.

programme.title: भारत की आवाज़
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on the inspiring journey of Mahatma Gandhi and highlights transformative events from his life
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता भारत के बेहतरीन वक्ताओं के जुनून और विचारों के बारे में बताते हैं और उनके सबसे प्रतिष्ठित भाषणों पर विशेषज्ञ अपने विचारों के साथ उन्हें साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: डिस्ट्रक्शन डिकोडेड
programme.sub-title: An in-depth look at catastrophic events, analysing the science behind natural and man-made disasters and exploring the causes and consequences through expert insights and CGI visuals
programme.desc: कार्यक्रम में प्राकृतिक और मानव निर्मित आपदाओं के पीछे के विज्ञान का विश्लेषण और अंतर्दृष्टि और सीजीआई दृश्यों के माध्यम से उनके कारणों और परिणामों पर जानकारी दी जाती है।.

programme.title: रक्त
programme.sub-title: The host explores the exile of King Rao Bundu and shares the story of Mohammed Ghori, a Turkish ruler who arrived in the 12th century
programme.desc: विशेषज्ञ राजाओं द्वारा राज्यों पर अधिकार करने के लिए किए गए कुछ प्रमुख युद्धों और हत्याओं पर विस्तार से चर्चा करते हैं, जिन्होंने आधुनिक भारत की दिशा को आकार दिया।.

programme.title: रेजिमेंट डायरीज़
programme.sub-title: The host narrates the rich history of the Mahar Regiment from the Maratha Empire to the post-Independence period
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता भारतीय सेना की विभिन्न रेजिमेंटों, उनके प्रशिक्षण, परंपराओं, इतिहास, योगदान और एक नागरिक के सैनिक बनने के तरीके के बारे में जानकारी प्रदान करते हैं।.

programme.title: प्लास्टिक फैन्टैस्टिक
programme.desc: Plastic Fantastic.

programme.title: व्हाट्स इन द नेम
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker delves into the fascinating stories behind the names of different places while also examining how certain people received various titles
programme.desc: फिल्मकार विभिन्न स्थानों के नामों के पीछे छिपी दिलचस्प कहानियों की पड़ताल करते हैं, साथ ही यह भी बताते हैं कि किस प्रकार उन्होंने विभिन्न उपाधियाँ प्राप्त की।.

programme.title: अदृश्य
programme.sub-title: In 1975, India sent actor-turned-spy Ravindra Kaushik into Pakistan, where he worked undercover for years gathering important military intelligence
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार, भारत के सबसे महान जासूसों के जीवन की खोज करते हैं, जिन्हें अपने मिशन को अंजाम देते वक्त खतरों का सामना करना पड़ा और राष्ट्रीय सम्मान के लिए अपने जीवन को जोखिम में डाला था।.

credits.actor: Sunny Hinduja (Ravindra Kaushik),Prashantt Guptha (Chand Bardai),Rajesh Khera (Jeevsiddhi),Nishant Singh (Shivaji),Annie Sekhon (Sanyukta),Taranjit Kaur (Durgavati Vohra),Mansi Multani (Azeez-un-Nisa)

programme.title: एपिक टेल्स ऑफ लव
programme.sub-title: A compilation of some of the most popular love stories featuring legendary characters based on various significant Indian historical and cultural legends
programme.desc: विभिन्न महत्वपूर्ण भारतीय ऐतिहासिक और सांस्कृतिक किंवदंतियों पर आधारित पौराणिक पात्रों वाली कुछ सबसे लोकप्रिय प्रेम कहानियों का संकलन।.

programme.title: ज़ख्मी
programme.sub-title: Convinced of Anand's innocence, his loyal brothers execute the high-stakes kidnapping of the presiding judge's daughter to force his release, whereupon the reckless gamble plunges them into jeopardy
programme.desc: आनंद की बेगुनाही से आश्वस्त होकर उसके वफादार भाई उसकी रिहाई के लिए न्यायाधीश की बेटी के अपहरण की साजिश को अंजाम देते हैं, जिसके बाद उनकी लापरवाही उन्हें खतरे में डालती है।.

credits.actor: Sunil Dutt,Asha Parekh,Rakesh Roshan,Johnny Walker,Reena Roy,Iftekhar,Tariq

programme.title: घरौंदा
programme.sub-title: A young couple navigates the challenges of moving to a big city and starting a home. However, the longer they stay, the more challenges they face with city life
programme.desc: सुदीप और छाया एक-दूसरे से शादी करने का फैसला करते हैं। वे बहुत कठिनाई से एक घर खरीदते हैं, लेकिन हैरान होते हैं, जब बिल्डर धोखेबाज़ निकलता है और उनके पैसे लेकर फरार हो जाता है।.

credits.actor: Amol Palekar,Zarina Wahab,Sadhu Meher,Shreeram Lagoo,Jalal Agha,Dina Pathak,T.P. Jain,Sudha Chopra

programme.title: శక్తిమాన్
programme.sub-title: A young college boy discovers his yogic superpowers and transforms into a superhero who protects the world from an evil villain
programme.desc: ఒక కళాశాల యువకుడు తన శక్తులను కనుగొని ప్రపంచాన్ని ఒక దుష్ట విలన్ నుండి రక్షించే సూపర్ హీరో గా రూపాంతరం చెందుతాడు.

programme.title: పాండా మరియు రూస్టర్ సాహసాలు
programme.sub-title: A Panda and a rooster become friends as they set out on exciting adventures to explore the vibrant cultures of various countries while promoting the concept of cultural diversity
programme.desc: పాండా, కోడిపుంజు స్నేహితులై సాంస్కృతిక వైవిధ్యాన్ని ప్రోత్సహిస్తూ, వివిధ దేశాల ఉత్సాహభరితమైన సంస్కృతులను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: డేంజర్ మౌస్
programme.sub-title: Danger Mouse, a talented secret agent, and his faithful sidekick, Ernest Penfold, do all they can to thwart the evil plans of Baron Silas von Greenback
programme.desc: రహస్య ఏజెంట్ డేంజర్ మౌస్, ఎర్నెస్ట్ పెన్ఫోల్డ్ తో కలిసి గ్రీన్ బ్యాక్ దుష్ట ప్రణాళికలను అడ్డుకోడానికి ప్రత్నిస్తారు.

programme.title: ఖుషీ రాముడు
programme.sub-title: Rama, together with his siblings and companions, embarks on numerous adventures while undergoing training at Vashist Ashram Gurukul
programme.desc: రాముడు, తన సోదరులు మరియు సహచరులతో కలిసి, వశిష్ఠ ఆశ్రమ గురుకులంలో శిక్షణ పొందుతూ అనేక సాహసయాత్రలను చేపడతాడు.

programme.title: వేక్ అప్ మ్యూజిక్ ఐడీ
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive collection of refreshing songs to help audiences kick-start the day, featuring popular artists and bands
programme.desc: ప్రముఖ కళాకారులు, బ్యాండ్‌ల పాటలతో, శ్రోతలు తమ రోజును ఉత్సాహంగా ప్రారంభించడానికి సహాయపడే ఉత్తేజకరమైన పాటల సమగ్ర సమాహారం.

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of stories from the Panchatantra, a collection of Indian fables, that helps to instil morals and values in children

programme.title: హ్యాపీ బర్త్ డే

programme.title: హైడీ
programme.sub-title: Heidi lives in Frankfurt and has a friend, Clara. However, after spending time at her grandfather's place in the countryside, she yearns to go back and spend time in the open mountain pasture
programme.desc: తన తాతయ్య అల్పోహితో కలిసి ఉండడానికి స్విస్ ఆల్ప్స్ వెళ్లిన హైడీ పట్ల ఆమె తాతయ్య అమితమైన ప్రేమను ఏర్పరచుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు సరి కొత్త
programme.sub-title: Moral-filled tales come to life as engaging characters navigate challenges, teaching lessons on wisdom, honesty and friendship through captivating storytelling
programme.desc: పాత్రలు సవాళ్లను అధిగమించి, జ్ఞానం, నిజాయితీ, స్నేహంపై పాఠాలను బోధించడం ద్వారా నైతికతతో నిండిన కథలు ప్రాణం పోసుకుంటాయి.

programme.title: శక్తిమాన్
programme.sub-title: A young college boy discovers his yogic superpowers and transforms into a superhero who protects the world from an evil villain
programme.desc: ఒక కళాశాల యువకుడు తన శక్తులను కనుగొని ప్రపంచాన్ని ఒక దుష్ట విలన్ నుండి రక్షించే సూపర్ హీరో గా రూపాంతరం చెందుతాడు.

programme.title: డేంజర్ మౌస్
programme.sub-title: Danger Mouse, a talented secret agent, and his faithful sidekick, Ernest Penfold, do all they can to thwart the evil plans of Baron Silas von Greenback
programme.desc: రహస్య ఏజెంట్ డేంజర్ మౌస్, ఎర్నెస్ట్ పెన్ఫోల్డ్ తో కలిసి గ్రీన్ బ్యాక్ దుష్ట ప్రణాళికలను అడ్డుకోడానికి ప్రత్నిస్తారు.

programme.title: ఖుషీ రాముడు
programme.sub-title: Rama, together with his siblings and companions, embarks on numerous adventures while undergoing training at Vashist Ashram Gurukul
programme.desc: రాముడు, తన సోదరులు మరియు సహచరులతో కలిసి, వశిష్ఠ ఆశ్రమ గురుకులంలో శిక్షణ పొందుతూ అనేక సాహసయాత్రలను చేపడతాడు.

programme.desc: ప్రముఖ కళాకారులు, బ్యాండ్‌ల పాటలతో, శ్రోతలు తమ రోజును ఉత్సాహంగా ప్రారంభించడానికి సహాయపడే ఉత్తేజకరమైన పాటల సమగ్ర సమాహారం.

programme.title: పాండా మరియు రూస్టర్ సాహసాలు
programme.sub-title: A Panda and a rooster become friends as they set out on exciting adventures to explore the vibrant cultures of various countries while promoting the concept of cultural diversity
programme.desc: పాండా, కోడిపుంజు స్నేహితులై సాంస్కృతిక వైవిధ్యాన్ని ప్రోత్సహిస్తూ, వివిధ దేశాల ఉత్సాహభరితమైన సంస్కృతులను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: హైడీ
programme.sub-title: Heidi lives in Frankfurt and has a friend, Clara. However, after spending time at her grandfather's place in the countryside, she yearns to go back and spend time in the open mountain pasture
programme.desc: తన తాతయ్య అల్పోహితో కలిసి ఉండడానికి స్విస్ ఆల్ప్స్ వెళ్లిన హైడీ పట్ల ఆమె తాతయ్య అమితమైన ప్రేమను ఏర్పరచుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Kristin Fiedler (Heidi),Thomas Ohrner (Peter),Erik Jelde (Alm-Öhi),Ursula Wolff (Klara),Tilly Lauenstein (Fräulein Rottenmeier),Leon Rainer

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు సరి కొత్త
programme.sub-title: Moral-filled tales come to life as engaging characters navigate challenges, teaching lessons on wisdom, honesty and friendship through captivating storytelling
programme.desc: పాత్రలు సవాళ్లను అధిగమించి, జ్ఞానం, నిజాయితీ, స్నేహంపై పాఠాలను బోధించడం ద్వారా నైతికతతో నిండిన కథలు ప్రాణం పోసుకుంటాయి.

programme.title: శక్తిమాన్
programme.sub-title: A young college boy discovers his yogic superpowers and transforms into a superhero who protects the world from an evil villain
programme.desc: ఒక కళాశాల యువకుడు తన శక్తులను కనుగొని ప్రపంచాన్ని ఒక దుష్ట విలన్ నుండి రక్షించే సూపర్ హీరో గా రూపాంతరం చెందుతాడు.

programme.title: పాండా మరియు రూస్టర్ సాహసాలు
programme.sub-title: A Panda and a rooster become friends as they set out on exciting adventures to explore the vibrant cultures of various countries while promoting the concept of cultural diversity
programme.desc: పాండా, కోడిపుంజు స్నేహితులై సాంస్కృతిక వైవిధ్యాన్ని ప్రోత్సహిస్తూ, వివిధ దేశాల ఉత్సాహభరితమైన సంస్కృతులను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: డేంజర్ మౌస్
programme.sub-title: Danger Mouse, a talented secret agent, and his faithful sidekick, Ernest Penfold, do all they can to thwart the evil plans of Baron Silas von Greenback
programme.desc: రహస్య ఏజెంట్ డేంజర్ మౌస్, ఎర్నెస్ట్ పెన్ఫోల్డ్ తో కలిసి గ్రీన్ బ్యాక్ దుష్ట ప్రణాళికలను అడ్డుకోడానికి ప్రత్నిస్తారు.

programme.title: ఖుషీ రాముడు
programme.sub-title: Rama, together with his siblings and companions, embarks on numerous adventures while undergoing training at Vashist Ashram Gurukul
programme.desc: రాముడు, తన సోదరులు మరియు సహచరులతో కలిసి, వశిష్ఠ ఆశ్రమ గురుకులంలో శిక్షణ పొందుతూ అనేక సాహసయాత్రలను చేపడతాడు.

programme.title: వేక్ అప్ మ్యూజిక్ ఐడీ
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive collection of refreshing songs to help audiences kick-start the day, featuring popular artists and bands
programme.desc: ప్రముఖ కళాకారులు, బ్యాండ్‌ల పాటలతో, శ్రోతలు తమ రోజును ఉత్సాహంగా ప్రారంభించడానికి సహాయపడే ఉత్తేజకరమైన పాటల సమగ్ర సమాహారం.

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of stories from the Panchatantra, a collection of Indian fables, that helps to instil morals and values in children
programme.desc: భారతీయ నీతి కథల సమాహారమైన, పంచతంత్ర కథల సమగ్ర సంకలనం, ఇది పిల్లలలో నైతికత, విలువలను పెంపొందించడానికి సహాయపడుతుంది.

programme.title: హ్యాపీ బర్త్ డే
programme.sub-title: Children celebrate their birthdays with a heart-touching note from their loved ones on the occasion of the special memorable day
programme.desc: పిల్లలు తమకు ఎంతో ప్రత్యేకమైన రోజు నాడు, తమ ప్రియమైన వారి నుండి హృదయాన్ని హత్తుకునే సందేశాలతో పుట్టినరోజు జరుపుకుంటారు.

programme.title: సూపర్ సింగూ
programme.desc: Super Singhoo.

programme.title: డోరా ప్రయాణం
programme.sub-title: A seven-year-old courageous girl, Dora, embarks on a trip with her best friend, Boots, in order to find something that interests her
programme.desc: ఏడేళ్ల అమ్మాయి డోరా తనకు ఆసక్తి ఉన్నదాన్ని కనుగొనడానికి తన స్నేహితుడు బూట్స్‌తో కలిసి విహారయాత్రకు బయలుదేరుతుంది.

programme.title: छोटा भीम
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: भीम एक असाधारण, शक्तिशाली और बुद्धिमान लड़का है। गाँव के सभी बच्चे उसे पसंद करते हैं, क्योंकि वह सभी की समस्याओं को हल करने में उनकी मदद करता है।.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: लिटिल कृष्ण
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: एक शरारती बच्चा छोटा कृष्ण वृंदावन गाँव में रहता है। वह क्रूर राक्षसों को ग्रामीणों पर हमला के लिए भेजने वाले एक दुष्ट राजा, कंस से उन्हें बचाने का फैसला करता है।.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: लिटिल कृष्णा मेलडिज
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna has fun getting caught up in all sorts of mischief with his friends in Vrindavan. But when the evil Kansa sends his minions to disrupt his life, he jumps into action
programme.desc: नन्हे कृष्ण वृंदावन में अपने दोस्तों के साथ तरह-तरह की शरारतें करते हुए मज़े करते हैं। लेकिन जब दुष्ट कंस उनके जीवन में खलल डालने के लिए अपने अनुचर भेजता है, तब वे तुरंत हरकत में आ जाते हैं।.

programme.title: लिटिल कृष्ण

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: छोटा भीम
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: भीम एक असाधारण, शक्तिशाली और बुद्धिमान लड़का है। गाँव के सभी बच्चे उसे पसंद करते हैं, क्योंकि वह सभी की समस्याओं को हल करने में उनकी मदद करता है।.

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: सम्पत चम्पत
programme.sub-title: Follow the hilarious misadventures of Sampat and Champat, two bumbling thieves who constantly hatch chaotic plans that backfire, landing them in endless trouble with the local police
programme.desc: सम्पत और चम्पत, दो चोर, लगातार ऐसी गड़बड़ योजनाएँ बनाते रहते हैं जो उन्हीं पर भारी पड़ जाती हैं, और जिसके चलते वे स्थानीय पुलिस के साथ कभी न खत्म होने वाली मुसीबतों में फँस जाते हैं।.

programme.title: ओमी नंबर 1
programme.sub-title: Omi, an ultra-rich nine-year-old heir, encounters hilarious and eye-opening situations that teach him about the realities of life
programme.desc: ओमी, नौ साल का एक अत्यधिक अमीर वारिस है, जिसका सामना ऐसी हास्यास्पद और आंखें खोल देने वाली स्थितियों से होता है जो उसे जीवन की वास्तविकताओं के बारे में सिखाती हैं।.

programme.title: छोटा भीम

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: द विदा एन एल अफ्रीका आर्डियंटे
programme.sub-title: Wild dogs adjust their reproductive cycle according to the season in order to protect their offsprings from the worst of nature
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता दुनिया के सबसे गर्म क्षेत्रों में जलवायु परिवर्तन के खतरे पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और बताते हैं कि कैसे जानवरों ने बदलते पर्यावरण के साथ खुद को समायोजित किया है।.

programme.title: सर्व्हायविंग अर्थ
programme.desc: From the producers of Walking with Dinosaurs comes an eight-part docuseries spanning 450 million years that revisits eight of Earth's major extinction events. Bringing some of the planet's most extraordinary geological eras to vivid life, the all-new footage created in partnership with real scientific insight explores the lives of animals we know and love, including mammoths, saber-toothed cats and dinosaurs, alongside some of evolution's truly unique creatures, like gorgonopsians, pliosaurs, glyptotherium and more. Together, they tell the story of how life has endured the impossible -- and never stopped fighting for survival.

programme.title: गैंग्स ऑफ बबून फॉल्स
programme.sub-title: Four groups of Chacma baboons compete with one another over food and territorial powers, on the border of Zimbabwe and Zambia
programme.desc: जिम्बाब्वे और जाम्बिया की सीमा पर, चकमा बबून के चार समूह भोजन और क्षेत्रीय शक्तियों के लिए एक दूसरे से प्रतिस्पर्धा करते हैं।.

programme.title: गैंग्स ऑफ बबून फॉल्स
programme.sub-title: As the Victoria gang struggles with a lot of new mouths to feed, the Zambia troops contemplate whether they can afford to take in outcasts from another town
programme.desc: जिम्बाब्वे और जाम्बिया की सीमा पर, चकमा बबून के चार समूह भोजन और क्षेत्रीय शक्तियों के लिए एक दूसरे से प्रतिस्पर्धा करते हैं।.

programme.title: द लास्ट रिफ़्यूजी

programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता तंजानिया में रिफ्ट वैली के पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र के पिछले कुछ वर्षों में विकसित होने और जीवित रहने के लिए संघर्ष करते हुए इसके जानवरों के बारे में बताते हैं।.

programme.title: डेड्लीएस्ट साउथ अफ्रीका
programme.sub-title: Kurt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's twelve most deadly snakes, as well as to educate and inspire people to see the value of these often misunderstood creatures

programme.sub-title: As the Victoria gang struggles with a lot of new mouths to feed, the Zambia troops contemplate whether they can afford to take in outcasts from another town
programme.desc: जिम्बाब्वे और जाम्बिया की सीमा पर, चकमा बबून के चार समूह भोजन और क्षेत्रीय शक्तियों के लिए एक दूसरे से प्रतिस्पर्धा करते हैं।.

programme.title: लायन्स व्हर्सेस हायनाज
programme.sub-title: Lioness and hyena mothers need to get their helpless offspring through their first tough months of life. However, they both make use of completely contrasting strategies in order to achieve it

programme.title: स्नो लेपर्ड्स विथ डॅन ओ'नील
programme.sub-title: Prowl the heart of Central Asia with biologist and naturalist Dan O'Neill as he races against time searching for the enigmatic snow leopard

programme.sub-title: During a spring season on the Gomoti River, mothers take charge as they train their young ones essential survival skills to thrive in the wild

programme.title: Surviving Earth
programme.desc: From the producers of Walking with Dinosaurs comes an eight-part docuseries spanning 450 million years that revisits eight of Earth's major extinction events. Bringing some of the planet's most extraordinary geological eras to vivid life, the all-new footage created in partnership with real scientific insight explores the lives of animals we know and love, including mammoths, saber-toothed cats and dinosaurs, alongside some of evolution's truly unique creatures, like gorgonopsians, pliosaurs, glyptotherium and more. Together, they tell the story of how life has endured the impossible -- and never stopped fighting for survival.

programme.desc: Her actual name is Sandra Lee, but she is so popular in her field of dermatology that she is known by most people as Dr. Pimple Popper. In 2015, Dr. Lee began to provide a window into her job by filming dermatological procedures -- some quite gruesome, like blackhead extractions and cyst dissections -- and posting them to her website and across other social media outlets. Lo and behold, Lee gained a prominent online fan base, including a YouTube channel with more than 3 million followers called `Popaholics.' Now comes a reality show on TLC, which says Lee is a `celebrity who has pioneered the fastest growing medical fascination in decades.'.

programme.desc: Her actual name is Sandra Lee, but she is so popular in her field of dermatology that she is known by most people as Dr. Pimple Popper. In 2015, Dr. Lee began to provide a window into her job by filming dermatological procedures -- some quite gruesome, like blackhead extractions and cyst dissections -- and posting them to her website and across other social media outlets. Lo and behold, Lee gained a prominent online fan base, including a YouTube channel with more than 3 million followers called `Popaholics.' Now comes a reality show on TLC, which says Lee is a `celebrity who has pioneered the fastest growing medical fascination in decades.'.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.sub-title: An Intensive Care Unit nurse and a banker try a 14-day survival challenge in the rough Mexican jungle. However, as food gets depleted, their will and skill to make it to the end are tested
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: नेकेड एण्ड अफ्रेड
programme.sub-title: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well
programme.desc: अजनबियों के कई जोड़ों को सुनसान और ख़तरनाक जंगलों में खूँखार वन्यजीवों से बचते हुए निर्वस्त्र रहकर सिर्फ दो चीज़ों की मदद से जीवित रहने की चुनौती को पूरा करना होगा।.

programme.title: నేకెడ్ అండ్ అఫ్రైడ్
programme.sub-title: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well
programme.desc: తీవ్ర వాతావరణంలో భయపడకుండా అరణ్యంలోని ప్రమాదకరమైన వన్యప్రాణుల నుండి బయటపడటానికి అపరిచితులు జత కడతారు.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.title: श्री सत्यमित्रानंद जी महाराज
programme.sub-title: Shri Satyamitranand Ji Maharaj, a religious leader, delivers a discourse and shares the teachings and philosophies of the holy scriptures, inspiring devotees to lead a righteous life
programme.desc: धर्मगुरु श्री सत्यमित्रानंद जी महाराज प्रवचन देते हैं और पवित्र शास्त्रों की शिक्षाएँ और दर्शन साझा करते हैं, तथा भक्तों को धार्मिक जीवन जीने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं।.

programme.title: पूज्य कौशिक जी महाराज
programme.sub-title: An eminent spiritual leader provides a comprehensive and detailed insight into important teachings and guides people on the right path
programme.desc: एक प्रख्यात आध्यात्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक महत्वपूर्ण शिक्षाओं के बारे में व्यापक और विस्तृत अंतर्दृष्टि प्रदान करते हैं और लोगों को सही मार्ग पर मार्गदर्शन करते हैं।.

programme.desc: Shri Amit Ji.

programme.title: पूज्य अनिकेत जी महाराज
programme.desc: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages the followers to take the path of spirituality.

programme.title: आराधना
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs sung to express veneration for divine figures in a bid to imbibe a sense of peace and calm in devotees
programme.desc: भक्तों में शांति और स्थिरता की भावना पैदा करने के उद्देश्य से दिव्य व्यक्तियों के प्रति श्रद्धा व्यक्त करने के लिए गाए गए भक्ति गीतों के व्यापक संकलन की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: भजन
programme.sub-title: An engaging compilation of spiritual hymns and divine melodies presented by renowned devotional singers from across the globe
programme.desc: दुनिया भर के प्रसिद्ध भक्ति गायकों द्वारा प्रस्तुत आध्यात्मिक भजनों और दिव्य धुनों का एक आकर्षक संकलन की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: सेल्फ रीअलिज़ेशन विथ साध्वी भगवती
programme.sub-title: The host engages in a discussion with a spiritual leader about life wisdom and pursuing the path of spirituality and devotion
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक के साथ जीवन ज्ञान और आध्यात्मिकता तथा भक्ति के मार्ग पर चलने के बारे में चर्चा करते हैं।.

programme.title: संकीर्तन
programme.sub-title: Hindu devotees and religious leaders gather to offer their sincere prayers to the Almighty and seek divine blessings through devotional songs
programme.desc: हिंदू भक्त और धार्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक ईश्वर की सच्ची प्रार्थना करने और भक्ति गीतों के माध्यम से दिव्य आशीर्वाद प्राप्त करने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं।.

programme.title: पूज्य गुरु मी मां जी
programme.sub-title: Pujya Guru Mee Maa ji
programme.desc: विषय विशेषज्ञ वेल्डिंग जोड़ों और उनकी कमियों पर प्रासंगिक उदाहरणों सहित व्यापक और विस्तृत व्याख्यान प्रस्तुत करते हैं।.

programme.title: सत्संग-अमृत
programme.sub-title: A spiritual leader explores the path to a pious life through the wisdom of Hinduism, sharing timeless precepts as well as teachings
programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक हिंदू धर्म के ज्ञान के माध्यम से पवित्र जीवन के मार्ग की खोज कर, कालातीत उपदेशों के साथ-साथ शिक्षाओं को भी साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: आचार्य बालकृषण जी
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the benefits of 'Ayurveda' and shares various treatments to help patients suffering from various ailments
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, 'आयुर्वेद' के लाभों पर प्रकाश डालते हैं तथा विभिन्न बीमारियों से पीड़ित रोगियों की मदद के लिए विभिन्न उपचार बताते हैं।.

programme.title: मोरारी बापू
programme.sub-title: Morari Bapu reads out and explains significant excerpts from the Rama Katha while giving his interpretation of the same and highlighting its importance
programme.desc: मोरारी बापू रामकथा के महत्वपूर्ण अंश पढ़ते और समझाते हैं, साथ ही उसकी अपनी व्याख्या और उसके महत्व पर प्रकाश डालते हैं।.

programme.title: योगऋषि स्वामी रामदेवजी महाराज
programme.sub-title: Baba Ramdev, a spiritual leader, delivers a discourse on spirituality and demonstrates various yoga asanas that enable oneself to lead a healthy and active lifestyle
programme.desc: आध्यात्मिक गुरु बाबा रामदेव आध्यात्मिकता पर प्रवचन देते हैं और विभिन्न योग आसनों का प्रदर्शन करते हैं जो स्वस्थ और सक्रिय जीवनशैली जीने में सक्षम बनाते हैं।.

programme.title: जतिन अग्रवाल जी
programme.sub-title: Jatin Agrawal Ji sings a series of soulful and melodious devotional songs in praise of the Almighty to foster a deep spiritual connection for the listeners
programme.desc: जतिन अग्रवाल जी सर्वशक्तिमान की स्तुति में हृदयस्पर्शी और मधुर भक्ति गीतों की एक श्रृंखला प्रस्तुत करते हैं, ताकि श्रोताओं के भीतर आध्यात्मिक जुड़ाव स्थापित हो सके।.

programme.title: महावीर शर्मा जी
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs, hymns and sacred chants in praise of the Almighty is played back-to-back
programme.desc: ईश्वर की स्तुति में भक्ति गीतों, भजनों और पवित्र मंत्रों का व्यापक संकलन लगातार प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: कृषण भैया सिरसा वाले
programme.sub-title: Bhaiya Krishan Das, a spiritual adept, reads passages and sacred verses from a religious text, explains their meaning and further sings hymns with the devotees
programme.desc: आध्यात्मिक गुरु भैया कृष्ण दास धार्मिक ग्रंथों से कुछ अंश और पवित्र श्लोक पढ़ते हुए उनका अर्थ समझाते हैं और भक्तों के साथ भजन गाते हैं।.

programme.title: వందేమాతరం సాంగ్
programme.sub-title: A compilation of patriotic songs glorifying the greatness and unity of India and performed by various artists is played back to back

programme.title: నాదస్వరం

programme.desc: ప్రొఫెషనల్ సంగీతకారులు ప్రేక్షకులను అలరించడానికి నాదస్వరం అనే పవన వాయిద్యంలో శాస్త్రీయ సంగీతాన్ని వాయిస్తారు.

programme.title: అర్చన
programme.sub-title: Religious priests and devotees offer prayers and perform sacred rituals to seek the blessings of the Almighty at a place of worship

programme.desc: ஒருவனை பின்தொடர்ந்து கிராமத்திற்கு செல்லும் பெண்.பறவைகள் மக்களை தாக்கி,விசித்திர நிகழ்வுகளில் அமைதி குழப்பமாக மாறுகிறது.

programme.title: ரகசிய கேள்விகள்
programme.sub-title: Renowned sexologist Dr Kamaraj provides expert advice on issues like impotency and erectile dysfunction, while offering treatment recommendations tailored to individual needs
programme.desc: பாலியல் நிபுணர் டாக்டர் காமராஜ்,ஆண்மைக்குறைவு-விறைப்புத்தன்மை பிரச்சினைகளில் ஆலோசனைகளை வழங்கி, பரிந்துரைகளை அளிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: பேரும் புகழும்
programme.sub-title: A woman who hails from a wealthy family craves for fame and looks for reasons to gain popularity. However, problems arise for her when she meets a car mechanic who saw her staging her own accident
programme.desc: செல்வந்தக் குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த ஒரு பெண், ஒரு கார் மெக்கானிக்கைச் சந்திக்கும்போது அவளுக்குப் பிரச்சனைகள் எழுகின்றன.

programme.title: அவளுக்கென்று ஒரு மனம்
programme.sub-title: Lalitha and Meena fall in love with the same man Kannan. Later, they go to extreme lengths to be with Kannan, the love of their life
programme.desc: ஒரே நபரான கண்ணனை நேசிக்கும் இரு தோழிகளான லலிதாவும் மீனாவும், அவருடன் சேர எந்த எல்லைக்கு வேண்டுமானாலும் செல்கின்றனர்.

programme.title: அய்யா வழி சாங்க்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Devotional artists and singers perform soulful hymns, celebrating Ayya Vaikundar, a 19th-century visionary and social reformer, inspiring faith and social change
programme.desc: பக்திப் பாடகர்கள் 19 ஆம் நூற்றாண்டின் தொலைநோக்கு பார்வையாளரான அய்யா வைகுண்டரைக் கொண்டாடி, பாடல்களைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders along with devotees recite morning prayers, conduct rituals and sing devotional songs in praise of various Hindu deities
programme.desc: மத தலைவர்கள் பக்தர்களுடன் காலை பிரார்த்தனைகளை ஓதி, சடங்குகளை நடத்தி, இந்து தெய்வங்களை போற்றி பாடல்களைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: இண்டியா சாங்க்
programme.sub-title: A group of experienced artists, musicians and singers perform a special patriotic song depicting the beauty, traditions and cultures of India
programme.desc: இந்தியாவின் அழகு, மரபுகள் மற்றும் கலாச்சாரங்களை சித்தரிக்கும் ஒரு சிறப்பு தேசபக்தி பாடலை நிகழ்த்தும் பாடகர்கள் குழு.

programme.title: கந்த சஷ்டி கவசம்
programme.sub-title: A melodious rendering of a hymn composed in praise of Lord Murugan is played in order to invoke the spirit of devotion
programme.desc: பக்தி உணர்வைத் தூண்டும் வகையில், முருகப் பெருமானைப் புகழ்ந்து இயற்றப்பட்ட ஒரு பாடலின் மெல்லிசைப் பாடல் இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: ஆலயதர்சனம்

programme.title: வெற்றிப்படிக்கட்டு

programme.title: Power to the People
programme.desc: `Power to the People' is an observational documentary exploring Britain's energy industry. The series films the daily activities of employees at SSE, one of Britain's `Big Six' energy companies. Over the course of a year, the cameras capture the reality behind electricity production versus consumption. As more and more old power stations are closed down, the company battles to find new sources to keep the country's power switched on. One such investment includes the world's second largest offshore wind farm, Greater Gabbard, where technicians discuss the potential of this 1.7-billion pound project.

programme.title: Power to the People
programme.desc: `Power to the People' is an observational documentary exploring Britain's energy industry. The series films the daily activities of employees at SSE, one of Britain's `Big Six' energy companies. Over the course of a year, the cameras capture the reality behind electricity production versus consumption. As more and more old power stations are closed down, the company battles to find new sources to keep the country's power switched on. One such investment includes the world's second largest offshore wind farm, Greater Gabbard, where technicians discuss the potential of this 1.7-billion pound project.

programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత దేశమంతటా పర్యటిస్తూ వివిధ ప్రాంతాలలోగల ప్రసిద్ధ దేవాలయాలను సందర్శించి, వారి చారిత్రక ప్రాముఖ్యతను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: చాగంటి ప్రవచనం
programme.sub-title: Chaganti Koteswara Rao elaborates on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: చాగంటి కోటేశ్వరరావు గారు భగవంతుడి బోధనలను వివరిస్తూ, భక్తులను ఆధ్యాత్మిక మార్గంలో నడవమని ప్రోత్సహిస్తారు.

programme.title: సామవేదం ప్రవచనం
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers discourses on the Sama Veda, one of the ancient Hindu scriptures, to a gathering of devotees in order to inspire them to follow the path of righteousness
programme.desc: ఒక ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు, ప్రాచీన గ్రంథాలలో ఒకటైన సామవేదంపై ఉపన్యాసమిచ్చి, ధర్మ మార్గాన్ని అనుసరించమని ప్రోత్సహిస్తారు.

programme.title: స్తోత్ర మాలికా
programme.sub-title: A compilation of devotional songs and verses is played back-to-back in order to encourage the audience to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: ప్రేక్షకులను ఆధ్యాత్మిక మార్గంలో నడవడానికి ప్రోత్సహించే ఉద్దేశ్యంతో, భక్తి గీతాలు, శ్లోకాల సంకలనాన్ని ప్రసారం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: ரிலீஜியஸ் ப்ரோக்ராம்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the teachings of the Almighty to enlighten the devotees and guide them on a path of spiritual growth
programme.desc: மத தலைவர் பக்தர்களுக்கு அறிவூட்டவும், ஆன்மீக பாதையில் வழிநடத்தவும் தேவனின் போதனைகள் குறித்த சொற்பொழிவை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs and hymns in praise of the divine written by various artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட தெய்வீகத்தைப் போற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்கள் மேலும் கீர்த்தனைகள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: கந்தசஷ்டிக்கவசம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of religious hymns and devotional songs in praise of Lord Murugan written by various artists
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட அப்பன் முருகனைப் புகழ்ந்து மத பாடல்கள் மற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: தினம் தினம் தரிசனம்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and spiritual significance of various Hindu temples and pilgrimage shrines across India
programme.desc: இந்தியா முழுவதும் உள்ள பல்வேறு இந்து கோவில்கள் மற்றும் புனித யாத்திரை தலங்களின் மத மற்றும் ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு சஹஸ்ரநாமம்
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees chant a Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Vishnu to seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: இந்து மதத் தலைவர்களும் பக்தர்களும் விஷ்ணுவின் 1,000 நாமங்களைக் கொண்ட சமஸ்கிருத பாடலைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஜி‌கே‌பி / பி‌பி / டி‌டி‌எல்‌எம்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருதல்.

programme.title: மதுரை காளியம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees gather at a pious shrine to offer their sincere prayers, worship the Almighty and seek divine blessings
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் சன்னதியில் கூடி தங்கள் பிரார்த்தனைகளை வழங்கி, இறைவனை வணங்கி, தெய்வீக ஆசீகளைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு ஷேத்திரம்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees assemble to perform a ceremonial ritual, offering worship and seeking the divine blessings of Lord Vishnu
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் கூடி, ஒரு சடங்கு சடங்கை செய்து, வழிபாடு செய்து, விஷ்ணுவின் தெய்வீக ஆசீர்வாதத்தைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular devotional songs in praise of deities performed by eminent artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் நடத்தப்படும் தெய்வங்களைப் போற்றும் பிரபலமான பக்திப் பாடல்கள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: சத்குரு
programme.sub-title: Sadhguru, a spiritual guru, gives a discourse on the teachings from the scriptures and urges his followers to walk on the path of righteousness
programme.desc: வேதங்களிலிருந்து போதனைகள் பற்றிய சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கி, பக்தர்களை நீதியின் பாதையில் செல்ல தூண்டும் ஆன்மீக குருவான சத்குரு.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீமத் பாகவதம்
programme.sub-title: A Hindu priest from Tirumala explains the chapters from Bhagavata Purana to the devotees of Lord Krishna in a detailed manner
programme.desc: ஆன்மீகத் தலைவர் ஆழ்ந்த ஞானத்தைப் பகிர்ந்து இந்து கடவுளான கிருஷ்ணரின் வாழ்க்கையை விவரிக்கும் தகவல் உரையை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: அம்மன் கோவில்கள்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and cultural significance of various temples and shrines dedicated to Goddess Amman
programme.desc: தேவி அம்மனுக்கான பல்வேறு கோவில்கள் மற்றும் சன்னதிகளின் மத மற்றும் கலாச்சார முக்கியத்துவத்தை எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

programme.title: இஷ்ட தெய்வம்
programme.sub-title: Renowned individuals extensively discuss their faith and share experiences of divine providence and miracles in their personal lives
programme.desc: தங்கள் நம்பிக்கையை பற்றி பேசுவதோடு, அவர்களின் வாழ்வில் தெய்வீக நம்பிக்கை-அற்புதங்கள் பற்றிய அனுபவங்களை பகிரும் நபர்கள்.

programme.title: சிவாலயம்
programme.sub-title: At a revered temple in Kerala, priests and devotees unite in devotion, performing sacred rituals and offering heartfelt prayers to Lord Shiva
programme.desc: கேரளாவின் பிரபல கோவிலில், பூசாரிகள்-பக்தர்கள் இணைந்து, சடங்குகளை செய்து, சிவனுக்கு இதயப்பூர்வ வழிபாடுகளை செய்கிறார்கள்.

programme.title: கும்பாபிஷேகம்
programme.sub-title: Devotees in large numbers visit a temple to perform a special ritual in order to synergise and unite the special powers of the deity
programme.desc: தெய்வத்தின் சிறப்பு சக்திகளை ஒருங்கிணைக்கவும் ஒன்றிணைக்கவும் ஒரு சிறப்பு சடங்கை செய்ய பக்தர்கள் கோயிலுக்கு வருகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஆர்ஜேஆர் - ஹெர்பல் ஸ்லாட்

programme.title: பன்னிரு திருமுறை

programme.title: बायोनिक मैक्स
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: एक बायोनिक गिनी पिग, मैक्स और उसके सुनहरी मछली का सबसे अच्छा दोस्त, प्रयोगशाला से भागने और वन्य जीवन में फिट होने की कोशिश करने के बाद आकर्षक रोमांच पर निकलते हैं।.

programme.title: हन्टर एक्स हन्टर
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: गॉन फ्रीक्स अपने गायब पिता को खोजने की आशा एक शिकारी बनने का निश्चय करता है, जो एक विशिष्ट पेशेवर है तथा दुर्लभ राक्षसों और खजानों का शिकार करने के लिए जाना जाता है।.

programme.title: वन पीस
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: रबर से बना एक युवक मंकी डी लफी और उसके समुद्री डाकुओं की टीम एक काल्पनिक खजाने को खोजने के लिए एक रोमांचक एडवेंचर पर निकल पड़ते हैं।.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: कितेरेत्सु
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: कितेरेत्सु, एक प्राथमिक विद्यालय का छात्र है जो लोगों की मदद करने के लिए अपने आविष्कारों का उपयोग करता है, और कोरोसुके, उसका रोबोट, अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों में भाग लेते हैं।.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: वी बेर बीयर्स
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: तीन भालू भाई, ग्रिजली, पांडा और आइस, सैन फ्रांसिस्को खाड़ी क्षेत्र में जीवन को अजीब तरीके से जीते हैं, जब वे आधुनिक मानव समाज में घुलने की कोशिश करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: लूनी ट्यून्स कार्टून्स
programme.sub-title: Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Sylvester, Tweety, Road Runner and many others go through a series of funny misadventures
programme.desc: बग्स बनी, डैफी डक, पोर्की पिग, सिल्वेस्टर, ट्वीटी, रोड रनर और कई मज़ेदार और अजीब-गरीब घटनाओं से गुज़रते हैं।.

programme.title: हन्टर एक्स हन्टर
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: गॉन फ्रीक्स अपने गायब पिता को खोजने की आशा एक शिकारी बनने का निश्चय करता है, जो एक विशिष्ट पेशेवर है तथा दुर्लभ राक्षसों और खजानों का शिकार करने के लिए जाना जाता है।.

programme.title: वन पीस
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: रबर से बना एक युवक मंकी डी लफी और उसके समुद्री डाकुओं की टीम एक काल्पनिक खजाने को खोजने के लिए एक रोमांचक एडवेंचर पर निकल पड़ते हैं।.

programme.desc: कितेरेत्सु, एक प्राथमिक विद्यालय का छात्र है जो लोगों की मदद करने के लिए अपने आविष्कारों का उपयोग करता है, और कोरोसुके, उसका रोबोट, अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों में भाग लेते हैं।.

programme.title: बायोनिक मैक्स
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: एक बायोनिक गिनी पिग, मैक्स और उसके सुनहरी मछली का सबसे अच्छा दोस्त, प्रयोगशाला से भागने और वन्य जीवन में फिट होने की कोशिश करने के बाद आकर्षक रोमांच पर निकलते हैं।.

programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: गॉन फ्रीक्स अपने गायब पिता को खोजने की आशा एक शिकारी बनने का निश्चय करता है, जो एक विशिष्ट पेशेवर है तथा दुर्लभ राक्षसों और खजानों का शिकार करने के लिए जाना जाता है।.

programme.title: वन पीस
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: रबर से बना एक युवक मंकी डी लफी और उसके समुद्री डाकुओं की टीम एक काल्पनिक खजाने को खोजने के लिए एक रोमांचक एडवेंचर पर निकल पड़ते हैं।.

programme.title: कितेरेत्सु
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: कितेरेत्सु, एक प्राथमिक विद्यालय का छात्र है जो लोगों की मदद करने के लिए अपने आविष्कारों का उपयोग करता है, और कोरोसुके, उसका रोबोट, अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों में भाग लेते हैं।.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: वी बेर बीयर्स
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: तीन भालू भाई, ग्रिजली, पांडा और आइस, सैन फ्रांसिस्को खाड़ी क्षेत्र में जीवन को अजीब तरीके से जीते हैं, जब वे आधुनिक मानव समाज में घुलने की कोशिश करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: हैरी एण्ड बन्नी
programme.sub-title: Harry is an aspiring magician who invents elaborate magic tricks to impress others. However, Bunnie, his mischievous stage rabbit, constantly outsmarts him and steals his spotlight
programme.desc: हैरी एक महत्वाकांक्षी जादूगर है जो दूसरों को प्रभावित करने के लिए नए-नए जादू के खेल ईजाद करता है। हालाँकि, बन्नी, उसका नटखट खरगोश, हर बार उसे मात दे देता है और सारी वाहवाही लूट लेता है।.

programme.title: बायोनिक मैक्स
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: एक बायोनिक गिनी पिग, मैक्स और उसके सुनहरी मछली का सबसे अच्छा दोस्त, प्रयोगशाला से भागने और वन्य जीवन में फिट होने की कोशिश करने के बाद आकर्षक रोमांच पर निकलते हैं।.

programme.title: वन पीस
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: रबर से बना एक युवक मंकी डी लफी और उसके समुद्री डाकुओं की टीम एक काल्पनिक खजाने को खोजने के लिए एक रोमांचक एडवेंचर पर निकल पड़ते हैं।.

programme.title: कितेरेत्सु
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: कितेरेत्सु, एक प्राथमिक विद्यालय का छात्र है जो लोगों की मदद करने के लिए अपने आविष्कारों का उपयोग करता है, और कोरोसुके, उसका रोबोट, अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों में भाग लेते हैं।.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.sub-title: Harry is an aspiring magician who invents elaborate magic tricks to impress others. However, Bunnie, his mischievous stage rabbit, constantly outsmarts him and steals his spotlight
programme.desc: हैरी एक महत्वाकांक्षी जादूगर है जो दूसरों को प्रभावित करने के लिए नए-नए जादू के खेल ईजाद करता है। हालाँकि, बन्नी, उसका नटखट खरगोश, हर बार उसे मात दे देता है और सारी वाहवाही लूट लेता है।.

programme.desc: சமூக, பொருளாதார மற்றும் அரசியல் பிரச்சினைகள் குறித்த சமீபத்திய புதுப்பிப்புகள் மற்றும் தலைப்புச் செய்திகள்.

programme.title: 2 மணி செய்திகள்

programme.desc: பல்வேறு அரசியல், பொருளாதார மற்றும் சமூகப் பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய தகவல்கள், முன்னேற்றங்கள் மற்றும் செய்திகள்.

programme.title: குற்ற சரித்திரம்
programme.sub-title: The host presents a comprehensive analysis of various heinous criminal offences committed by individuals, examining their motives and actions
programme.desc: தனிநபர்களால் செய்யப்பட்ட பல்வேறு கொடூரமான குற்றங்களின் பகுப்பாய்வை முன்வைத்து, நோக்கங்கள்-செயல்களை ஆய்வு செய்கிறது.

programme.title: ஆயுத எழுத்து
programme.sub-title: Kaliammal, a bold and manipulative woman, tries to keep the village under her fist. However, Indra, a young and ambitious sub-collector, vows to put an end to Kaliammal's evil regime
programme.desc: தனது கட்டுப்பாட்டில் கிராமத்தை கையாள நினைக்கும் தைரியமான காளியம்மாளின் ஆட்சிக்கு முடிவுக்கட்டும் துணை கலெக்டரான இந்திரா.

credits.actor: Mounika (Kaliammal),Sharanya Turadi (Indra),Anand Selvan (Sakthivel),Janani Ashok Kumar,Syamantha Kiran,Amzath Khan (Sakthivel),Sreethu Nair (Indra)

programme.desc: மத தலைவர்கள் கடவுளை புகழ்ந்து பக்தர்களுக்கு சொற்பொழிவுகளை வழங்குவதோடு, பைபிளிலிருந்து பல்வேறு வசனங்களை ஓதுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: சன் ஆஃப் காட்
programme.sub-title: Born to the Virgin Mary and Joseph, Jesus Christ and his teachings spark a revolution that puts him in danger of being persecuted by the Roman Empire
programme.desc: கன்னி மேரி-ஜோசப்க்கு பிறந்த இயேசு புரட்சியை தூண்டியது, அது அவரை ரோமானிய பேரரசால் துன்புறுத்தப்படும் அபாயத்தில் உள்ளது.

programme.title: பெத்தேன் யாட்சர்
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders perform special prayers for pregnant women that allows them to keep calm and also helps in soothing the baby in the womb
programme.desc: மத தலைவர்கள் கர்ப்பிணிப் பெண்களின் கருப்பையில் இருக்கும் குழந்தையை அமைதிப்படுத்த சிறப்பு பிரார்த்தனைகளை செய்கிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஹலோ குட்டீஸ்
programme.sub-title: Young hosts interact with children over the phone and ask them questions related to Christianity and Jesus Christ while playing their favorite devotional songs
programme.desc: தொலைபேசியில் குழந்தைகளிடம் கேள்விகளை கேட்டு, அவர்களுக்குப் பிடித்தமான பக்திப் பாடல்களை வழங்கும் தொகுப்பாளர்.

programme.title: கர்த்தர் நல்லவர்
programme.sub-title: Chandra Rajasekar provides a detailed discourse on various spiritual teachings and encourages devotees to lead a faithful life
programme.desc: சந்திர ராஜசேகர் பல்வேறு ஆன்மீக போதனைகள் பற்றிய சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கி, விசுவாசமான வாழ்க்கையை வாழ பக்தர்களை ஊக்குவிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: நான் ஏன் பிறந்தேன்
programme.sub-title: The host invites Christian devotional songwriters and spiritual leaders to share the events that inspired them to write songs about the Lord

programme.title: தி சூசென்

programme.title: द स्पाइसी कासुकाबे डांसर्स इन इंडिया
programme.sub-title: Following the Kasukabe Defence's victory, which secures a journey to India, Shinnosuke and Bo-chan venture into a dubious general store and discover a backpack containing a frightening mystery
programme.desc: कासुकाबे रक्षा की जीत के बाद, भारत की यात्रा सुनिश्चित हो जाती है, शिनोसुके और बो-चान एक संदिग्ध जनरल स्टोर में जाते हैं और एक बैग पाते हैं जिसमें एक भयावह रहस्य छिपा होता है।.

programme.title: शिन चान मूवी - विलन और दुल्हन
programme.sub-title: Shin-chan is approached by his time-traveling future bride-to-be Tamiko, who asks him to help save his adult self from the ruler of Neo Tokyo
programme.desc: बीते समय की यात्रा करके शिन-चैन की होने वाली दुल्हन तामिको असपे पास आती है और उससे नियो टोक्यो के शासक से खुद के बड़े रूप को बचाने को कहती है।.

programme.desc: அதிவேகமான இளம் நிஞ்ஜா நருட்டோ உசுமாக்கி தனது கிராமத்தில் ஹோகேஜ் ஆக ஒப்புதல் மற்றும் அங்கீகாரத்தை தொடர்ந்து தேடுகிறார்.

programme.title: ஒன் பஞ்ச் மேன்
programme.sub-title: The Class S heroes strive to fend off the surge of monster invasions as the Super Fight tournament approaches its grand climax
programme.desc: அஞ்சத்தக்க சூப்பர் ஹீரோவான சைதாமா ஒரே அடியில் எதிரியை வீழ்த்துபவர், சலிப்பு மற்றும் மனச்சோர்வு உணர்வுகளுடன் தவிக்கிறான்.

programme.title: ஒன் பஞ்ச் மேன்

programme.sub-title: Following the Kasukabe Defence's victory, which secures a journey to India, Shinnosuke and Bo-chan venture into a dubious general store and discover a backpack containing a frightening mystery
programme.desc: భారతదేశ ప్రయాణాన్ని తర్వాత 'కసుకాబే డిఫెన్స్' విజయం అనంతరం, షిన్నోసుకే, బో-చాన్ ఒక జనరల్ స్టోర్‌లోకి ప్రవేశిస్తారు.

programme.sub-title: Shin-chan is approached by his time-traveling future bride-to-be Tamiko, who asks him to help save his adult self from the ruler of Neo Tokyo
programme.desc: టైం ట్రావెల్ చేసివచ్చిన షిన్ చాన్ కి కాబోయే భార్య టమికో, నియో టోక్యో పాలకుడు నుండి తన వయోజన రూపాన్ని కాపాడమని కోరుతుంది.

programme.sub-title: The case seems to be solved. A member of the company admits to having killed the victim to avoid being fired. But Gaspard believes that the killer was manipulated into taking action. Who could benefit from such a Machiavellian plan?

programme.desc: ఒక మతప్రబోధకుడు క్రైస్తవమతంపై ప్రసంగించి, పవిత్రాత్మ బహుమతుల ప్రాముఖ్యత, పరిపూర్ణమైన జీవితంలో వారి పాత్రను వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: క్రీస్తు సందేశం ఫాదర్ గోపు ప్రకాష్
programme.sub-title: A religious leader elaborates on various teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to embrace the path of spirituality
programme.desc: ఒక మతప్రబోధకుడు ప్రభువు వివిధ బోధలను బోధిస్తూ, అనుచరులను మతపరమైన మార్గాన్ని స్వీకరించమని ప్రోత్సహిస్తారు.

programme.title: వర్డ్ ఆఫ్ గాడ్
programme.sub-title: A Christian religious leader delivers a discourse based on the teachings of the Bible to lead devotees on the right path
programme.desc: భక్తులను సన్మార్గంలో నడిపించడానికి, ఒక క్రైస్తవ మత బోధకుడు బైబిల్ బోధనల ఆధారంగా ఒక ప్రసంగాన్ని అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: కరుణ జపమాల చాప్లెట్ ఆర్‌ఐపీ
programme.sub-title: Christian religious leaders and worshippers gather to recite holy verses from sacred texts and implore divine favour from the Almighty
programme.desc: మత ప్రబోధకులు, భక్తులు పవిత్ర గ్రంథాలలోని దివ్య వాక్యాలను పఠించడానికి, ప్రభువు అనుగ్రహాన్ని పొందడానికి సమావేశమవుతారు.

programme.title: గుడ్ సమరిటన్
programme.sub-title: The host showcases the noble work of good Samaritans and organisations dedicated to social service, charity and humanitarian efforts, by exploring their impact on society and their way of functioning
programme.desc: స్వచ్ఛంద పని చేసే పవిత్ర వ్యక్తులు మరియు సంస్థల గురించి మరియు వారి పనితీరు మార్గం గురించి తెలుసుకోండి.

programme.title: దివ్యవాక్కు
programme.sub-title: A spiritual leader offers a discourse replete with religious fervour to apprise devout Christians of divine providence and relevant teachings from the Bible
programme.desc: ఒక మతప్రబోధకుడు దైవ దర్శనం, బైబిలు బోధనల గురించి క్రైస్తవులకు తెలియచేయడానికి ఉత్సాహవంతమైన ప్రసంగం అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: జాయ్‌ఫుల్ మిస్టరీస్
programme.sub-title: Devotees gather in large numbers at a church in order to pray the rosary and invoke the divine blessings of Jesus Christ
programme.desc: జపమాల ప్రార్థన చేయడానికి, యేసుక్రీస్తు దైవిక ఆశీర్వాదాలను పొందడానికి భక్తులు పెద్ద సంఖ్యలో చర్చిలో సమావేశమవుతారు.

programme.title: పునీతుల ప్రార్థన
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees come together in a church to sing spiritual hymns and perform rituals in praise of the Almighty
programme.desc: మత బోధకులు, భక్తులు ప్రభువును స్తుతిస్తూ గీతాలను ఆలపించడానికి, ఆచారాలను నిర్వహించడానికి ఒక చర్చిలో సమావేశమవుతారు.

programme.title: సాంగ్స్
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular and famous songs produced and composed by talented musical artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: ప్రతిభావంతులైన సంగీత కళాకారులు రూపొందించిన మరియు స్వరపరిచిన ప్రసిద్ధ పాటల సమగ్ర సంకలనం త్వరితగతిన ప్రసారం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: త్రికాల జపము
programme.desc: Thrikala Japamu.

programme.title: శ్రీరామ సుప్రభాతం

programme.title: ఆంజనేయ సహస్రనామం

programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक ध्यान के महत्व तथा मन, शरीर और प्रार्थना के बीच संबंध पर विस्तृत तरीके से प्रवचन प्रदान करते हैं।.

programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, जीवन की चुनौतियों के बारे में गहन अंतर्दृष्टि प्रदान करते हैं, तथा आध्यात्मिक समझ के माध्यम से आत्म-साक्षात्कार, शांति और व्यक्तिगत विकास की दिशा में मार्गदर्शन करते हैं।.

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: डिवोशनल मेलोज़
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional hymns and songs are played back to back, praising the Almighty and seeking divine blessings
programme.desc: भक्ति भजनों और गीतों का एक व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जिसमें ईश्वर की स्तुति की जाती है और दिव्य आशीर्वाद की कामना की जाती है।.

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: डिवोशनल मेलोज़
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional hymns and songs are played back to back, praising the Almighty and seeking divine blessings
programme.desc: भक्ति भजनों और गीतों का एक व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जिसमें ईश्वर की स्तुति की जाती है और दिव्य आशीर्वाद की कामना की जाती है।.

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: डिवोशनल मेलोज़
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional hymns and songs are played back to back, praising the Almighty and seeking divine blessings
programme.desc: भक्ति भजनों और गीतों का एक व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जिसमें ईश्वर की स्तुति की जाती है और दिव्य आशीर्वाद की कामना की जाती है।.

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: डिवोशनल मेलोज़
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional hymns and songs are played back to back, praising the Almighty and seeking divine blessings
programme.desc: भक्ति भजनों और गीतों का एक व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जिसमें ईश्वर की स्तुति की जाती है और दिव्य आशीर्वाद की कामना की जाती है।.

programme.title: வி1 மர்டர் கேஸ்
programme.sub-title: Agni, a forensic expert with nyctophobia, decides to take on a murder investigation of a young girl. However, he faces many challenges in his quest
programme.desc: ஒரு இளம் பெண்ணின் கொலை விசாரணையை எடுக்க தீர்மானித்தபோது பல சவால்களை எதிர்கொள்ளும் ஃபாரன்சிக் நிபுணர் அக்னி.

credits.actor: Ram Arun Castro (Agni),Mime Gopi (Chain snatcher's father),Lijeesh (Inba),Vishnupriya Pillai (Luna),Gayathri Raja (Narmadha),Ramachandran (Agni's assistant)

programme.title: இந்தவார கலகலப்பு
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of hilarious comedy scenes, featuring popular artists, is played back-to-back for the entertainment of the viewers
programme.desc: கலைஞர்கள் பங்கேற்கும் நகைச்சுவைக் காட்சிகளின் தொகுப்பு பார்வையாளர்களின் பொழுதுபோக்கிற்காக தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: தூங்காத கண்ணென்று ஒன்று
programme.sub-title: Devi secretly weds Ravi, who later leaves for a career in films. Chaos unfolds when Devi's father decides to arrange her marriage with another man

credits.actor: Mohan (Ravi),Ambika Viji (Devi),S.V.Shekher (Unni Kosthepu),S. Varalakshmi,Ponni,V.K. Ramasamy (Ravi's father),M. R. Krishnamurthy,V. M. John,Vaani
