programme.title: லா விடா என் எல் ஆஃப்ரிக்கா ஆர்டெண்ட்
programme.sub-title: Many species that live in extreme places slow down their cycles of reproduction and breeding. Wild dogs speed up the process by several weeks to avoid having to expose their pups to the dangers of heat
programme.desc: உலகின் வெப்பமான பகுதிகளில் ஏற்படும் காலநிலை மாற்றம், மாறிவரும் சூழலுக்கு விலங்குகள் தங்களை மாற்றிக் கொள்வதை பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: சர்வைவிங்க் அர்த்
programme.sub-title: A matriarch elephant leads her herd on a journey to find water, encountering an alien continent where they must adapt to a new way of life to survive
programme.desc: An eight-part docuseries exploring Earth's major eras and extinction events across 450 million years alongside the creatures who fought to survive.

programme.title: கேங்க்ஸ் ஆஃப் பாபூன் ஃபால்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: As lockdown continues, the streets of Victoria Falls have become eerily deserted, and the gangs must now figure out new ways to survive in a dramatically changed world
programme.desc: சக்மா பாபூன்களின் நான்குகுழுக்கள் ஜிம்பாப்வே மேலும் ஜாம்பியாவின் எல்லையில் உணவு-பிராந்திய சக்திகளுக்கு போட்டியிடுகின்றன.

programme.title: கேங்க்ஸ் ஆஃப் பாபூன் ஃபால்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: As the Victoria gang struggle with lots of new mouths to feed, another troop must decide whether to let outcasts from outer town in
programme.desc: சக்மா பாபூன்களின் நான்குகுழுக்கள் ஜிம்பாப்வே மேலும் ஜாம்பியாவின் எல்லையில் உணவு-பிராந்திய சக்திகளுக்கு போட்டியிடுகின்றன.

programme.title: தி லாஸ்ட் ரெஃப்யூஜ்
programme.sub-title: In the Philippines, Aeta tribesmen battle industrial encroachment on ancestral lands
programme.desc: உயிர்வாழ்வதற்காக போராடும் அதன் விலங்குகளின் மீள்தன்மையை வெளிப்படுத்துவதையும் திரைப்படத் தயாரிப்பாளர்கள் காட்டுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: டெட்லியஸ்ட் சௌத் ஆஃப்ரிக்கா
programme.sub-title: Kurt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's 12 most deadly snakes
programme.desc: தென்னாப்பிரிக்காவின் கொடிய பன்னிரண்டு பாம்புகளை தேடி, தவறாக அறியப்படும் அவற்றின் மதிப்பை கற்பிக்கும் குர்ட் கிரீன்வுட்.

programme.title: ஸ்னோ லெப்பர்ட்ஸ் வித் டான் ஓ'நீல்
programme.sub-title: Navigating the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan O'Neill as he searches for 'The Dude', the largest snow leopard ever recorded
programme.desc: உயிரியலாளரும் இயற்கை ஆர்வலருமான டான் ஓ நீல், ஆராய்ச்சி மையத்தை உருவாக்கி பனிச்சிறுத்தையை பற்றி ஆய்வு செய்ய முயலுகிறார்.

programme.title: ஆஸ்ஸி ஸ்னேக் வ்ராங்க்ளர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Chris and Jess head to the outskirts of Sydney, Australia, to capture an elusive red-bellied black snake; a coastal carpet python needs help out of a drainpipe; Stuart and Olivia make a rare find
programme.desc: ஆஸ்திரேலிய வீடுகளில் மறைந்திருக்கும் உலகின் கொடிய பாம்புகளை பிடிக்க முயலுகையில் ஆபத்துகளை எதிர்கொள்ளும் நிபுணர்கள்.

programme.title: ஆஸ்ஸி ஸ்னேக் வ்ராங்க்ளர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Chris and Stu come face-to-face with a giant red-bellied black snake that's taking shelter in a car's engine. In South Australia, Mick and Adele are helping local snake catcher, Dan, with one of his busiest snake catching seasons on record
programme.desc: ஆஸ்திரேலிய வீடுகளில் மறைந்திருக்கும் உலகின் கொடிய பாம்புகளை பிடிக்க முயலுகையில் ஆபத்துகளை எதிர்கொள்ளும் நிபுணர்கள்.

programme.title: இத்தாலி : தி லாஸ்ட் வில்டர்னஸ் இயர் 1
programme.sub-title: The biological cycle of Abruzzi's chamois, which are endemic to the highest mountains of Central Italy. The Apennine chamois are an ancient species, but today, they are under serious threat. They are the survivors of a prehistoric species
programme.desc: ஐரோப்பாவின் மையப்பகுதியில் உள்ள டானூப் நதிக்கரை காடுகளின் சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்பில் செழித்து வளரும் வனவிலங்கு வாழ்விடம்.

programme.title: சைனா'ஸ் வைல்ட் சீக்ரெட்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: In southwestern China, towering mountains provide shelter for nearly 2,000 wild giant pandas. Giant Panda National Park is three times the size of Yellowstone and is home to over 10,000 species
programme.desc: Spanning five of China's hidden wildlife havens, exploring some of the world's most diverse ecosystems. From lush rainforests to soaring mountains, we uncover never-before-seen animal behaviours.

programme.title: சைனா'ஸ் வைல்ட் சீக்ரெட்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: There aren't many rainforests in China, but Hainan Island, known as China's Hawaii, is an exception. The island's isolation for millions of years has allowed unique species to develop
programme.desc: Spanning five of China's hidden wildlife havens, exploring some of the world's most diverse ecosystems. From lush rainforests to soaring mountains, we uncover never-before-seen animal behaviours.

programme.title: சைனா'ஸ் வைல்ட் சீக்ரெட்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: At the Roof of the World, we find the sources of three great rivers: the Huang He, the Yangtze, and the Mekong. These rich waterways allow genetically unique species to flourish
programme.desc: Spanning five of China's hidden wildlife havens, exploring some of the world's most diverse ecosystems. From lush rainforests to soaring mountains, we uncover never-before-seen animal behaviours.

programme.title: Fear on the Savannah
programme.desc: Authorities introduced lions in a rehabilitated national park where only herbivores lived, and fear overtook the park.

programme.title: டாக்ஸ் இன் த லாண்ட் ஆஃப் லயன்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: We follow the unforgettable journey of a family of wild dogs in Zimbabwe and witness rarely seen behaviour, from tender moments with newborn pups, to the thrills of hunting wildebeest, to close encounters with their greatest enemy - the lion
programme.desc: ஜிம்பாப்வேயில் நெருக்கமாக பிணைக்கப்பட்ட காட்டு நாய்களின் அசாதாரண பயணத்தையும் அவற்றின் வேட்டையாடும் தருணங்களையும் அறிக.

programme.title: ரைஸ் ஆஃப் ஜாகுவார்ஸ்
programme.desc: Rise Of Jaguars.

programme.title: ரைஸ் ஆஃப் ஜாகுவார்ஸ்
programme.desc: Rise Of Jaguars.

programme.title: சர்ச் ஃபார் தி கிங் கோப்ரா
programme.sub-title: Austin Stevens, a photographer and herpetologist, travels to the remote jungles of Southern India in pursuit of the world's largest venomous snake, the king cobra
programme.desc: ஆஸ்டின் ஸ்டீவன்ஸ், உலகின் மிகப்பெரிய விஷப் பாம்பான ராஜ நாகத்தைத் தேடி தென்னிந்தியாவின் தொலைதூரக் காடுகளுக்கு செல்கிறார்.

programme.title: கோல்டன் ஈகிள்: கால் ஆஃப் த வைல்ட்
programme.sub-title: Soaring between high rugged peaks and yawning valleys a golden eagle chick begins life in the high Alps
programme.desc: Experience the high Alps as young golden eagles face fierce rivals, brutal weather and steep odds to survive their first year.

programme.title: லயன்ஸ் வெர்சஸ் ஹைனாஸ்
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker delves into the misunderstood rivalry between lions and hyenas, shedding light on their conflict and offering new insights into their complex relationship
programme.desc: சிங்கங்களுக்கும் ஹைனாக்களுக்கும் இடையிலான போட்டியையும், அவற்றின் மோதலையும்,சிக்கலான உறவையும் ஆராயும் இயக்குனர்.

programme.title: ரெயின்ஃபாரெஸ்ட் ரிவைல்ட்
programme.desc: Rainforest Rewild.

programme.title: லா விடா என் எல் ஆஃப்ரிக்கா ஆர்டெண்ட்
programme.sub-title: Being thin, having black patches on light-coloured fur, hyperventilating and licking itself regularly to evaporate saliva are the cheetah's most effective tricks to cope with its scorching environment
programme.desc: உலகின் வெப்பமான பகுதிகளில் ஏற்படும் காலநிலை மாற்றம், மாறிவரும் சூழலுக்கு விலங்குகள் தங்களை மாற்றிக் கொள்வதை பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: வைல்ட் பை நேச்சர்
programme.sub-title: WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. programme.desc: ஆஸ்திரேலிய வீடுகளில் மறைந்திருக்கும் உலகின் கொடிய பாம்புகளை பிடிக்க முயலுகையில் ஆபத்துகளை எதிர்கொள்ளும் நிபுணர்கள்.

programme.sub-title: Many species that live in extreme places slow down their cycles of reproduction and breeding. Wild dogs speed up the process by several weeks to avoid having to expose their pups to the dangers of heat
programme.desc: உலகின் வெப்பமான பகுதிகளில் ஏற்படும் காலநிலை மாற்றம், மாறிவரும் சூழலுக்கு விலங்குகள் தங்களை மாற்றிக் கொள்வதை பற்றி அறிக.

programme.sub-title: Tigerfish are terrifying freshwater predators. Extreme angler Andy Coetzee undertakes a hazardous journey to study the giant-sized species in their habitat in the Congo
programme.desc: மீன் இனமான டைகர்ஃபிஷின் நடத்தையை ஆய்வு செய்வதற்காக ஒரு பாதுகாவலர் ஆப்பிரிக்காவின் ஆறுகள் வழியாக பயணம் செய்கிறார்.

programme.sub-title: The forests of northeastern China are home to big cats, including Siberian tigers. The crew have a look at the national park established there to support recovery of these endangered animals
programme.desc: Spanning five of China's hidden wildlife havens, exploring some of the world's most diverse ecosystems. From lush rainforests to soaring mountains, we uncover never-before-seen animal behaviours.

programme.title: த ப்ரதர்'ஸ் ப்ரைட்

programme.sub-title: In the Philippines, Aeta tribesmen battle industrial encroachment on ancestral lands

programme.sub-title: As the Victoria gang struggle with lots of new mouths to feed, another troop must decide whether to let outcasts from outer town in
programme.desc: சக்மா பாபூன்களின் நான்குகுழுக்கள் ஜிம்பாப்வே மேலும் ஜாம்பியாவின் எல்லையில் உணவு-பிராந்திய சக்திகளுக்கு போட்டியிடுகின்றன.

programme.title: டெட்லியஸ்ட் சௌத் ஆஃப்ரிக்கா
programme.sub-title: Kurt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's 12 most deadly snakes
programme.desc: தென்னாப்பிரிக்காவின் கொடிய பன்னிரண்டு பாம்புகளை தேடி, தவறாக அறியப்படும் அவற்றின் மதிப்பை கற்பிக்கும் குர்ட் கிரீன்வுட்.

programme.title: லயன்ஸ் வெர்சஸ் ஹைனாஸ்
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker delves into the misunderstood rivalry between lions and hyenas, shedding light on their conflict and offering new insights into their complex relationship
programme.desc: சிங்கங்களுக்கும் ஹைனாக்களுக்கும் இடையிலான போட்டியையும், அவற்றின் மோதலையும்,சிக்கலான உறவையும் ஆராயும் இயக்குனர்.

programme.title: ஸ்னோ லெப்பர்ட்ஸ் வித் டான் ஓ'நீல்
programme.sub-title: Prowling the heart of Central Asia with biologist and naturalist Dan O'Neill as he races against time searching for the enigmatic snow leopard
programme.desc: உயிரியலாளரும் இயற்கை ஆர்வலருமான டான் ஓ நீல், ஆராய்ச்சி மையத்தை உருவாக்கி பனிச்சிறுத்தையை பற்றி ஆய்வு செய்ய முயலுகிறார்.

programme.title: Fight For Life
programme.desc: Discover the story of the rehabilitation of an African national park. After the first step of successfully acclimatising herbivores, it is time to reintroduce lions. But with them comes predation, and suddenly, fear overtakes the park.

programme.title: பிக் கேட்ஸ் ஸ்மால் வர்ல்ட்
programme.sub-title: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba are teaching their cubs survival skills whilst keeping them out of the jaws of big male cats
programme.desc: போட்ஸ்வானாவின் கோமோட்டி நதியில் தங்கி தங்கள் திறமைகளால் போட்டியாளர்களை தடுக்கும் மூன்று பெரிய பூனை குடும்பங்கள்.

programme.title: இத்தாலி : தி லாஸ்ட் வில்டர்னஸ் இயர் 1
programme.sub-title: The biological cycle of Abruzzi's chamois, which are endemic to the highest mountains of Central Italy. The Apennine chamois are an ancient species, but today, they are under serious threat. They are the survivors of a prehistoric species
programme.desc: ஐரோப்பாவின் மையப்பகுதியில் உள்ள டானூப் நதிக்கரை காடுகளின் சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்பில் செழித்து வளரும் வனவிலங்கு வாழ்விடம்.

programme.title: டெக்சாஸ் கேட்டர் சேவர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Gary, Arlie, and Jake search for a gator in an RV park and Shannon finds a timber rattlesnake at a local business. The team trades gators with their sister park in South Padre Island, Texas
programme.desc: கேரி சௌரேஜ் குழுவினர், பல இடங்களிலிருந்து முதலைகளை மீட்டு, ஒரு புதிய சூழலில் அவை நலமாக வாழ்வதற்கு வழிவகை செய்கின்றனர்.

programme.title: ஐபீரியன் வைப்பர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Exploring the behaviour, unique characteristics, and survival strategies of venomous vipers in the Iberian Peninsula
programme.desc: ஐபீரிய தீபகற்பத்தில் உள்ள விஷ பாம்புகளின் நடத்தை, பண்புகள் மற்றும் உயிர்வாழும் உத்திகளை ஆராயும் திரைப்பட தயாரிப்பாளர்.

programme.title: டைகரஸ் ப்ளட்
programme.sub-title: Tigers in general are believed to be solitary hunters. But in the forests of Central India, a gang of females learned to hunt co-operatively, taking down large, dangerous prey
programme.desc: ஒரு புலி கூட்டம் எவ்வாறு வேட்டையாடுகிறது என்பதற்கான விதிகளை மாற்றி எழுதும் மத்திய இந்தியாவின் நான்கு புலிகளின் வாழ்க்கை.

programme.title: நேச்சுரல் பார்ன் மான்ஸ்டர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Sean Duggan travels to Thailand to investigate the giant snakehead fish in its native habitat. Sean's expedition takes him from Thailand to snakehead-infested Arkansas to see if this killer fish can be stopped
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures - from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles - in `Natural Born Monsters'. When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: த ஜூ
programme.sub-title: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. programme.title: శివ
programme.sub-title: Shiva is a brave and intelligent child who stays with his grandparents in Vedas City. He sets out with his gang of friends to save the citizens from all sorts of evil
programme.desc: వేదాస్ నగరంలో తన బామ్మాతాతాలతో నివసించే ధైర్యంగల శివ, మిత్రులతో కలిసి తన నగరాన్ని దుష్ట శక్తుల నుండి కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Nilufer Middey,Sonal Kaushal,Rupa Bhimani,Anamay Verma,Aditya Jaiswal,Brij Bhushan Sawhney,Manoj Pandey

programme.title: పాక్ పకావు
programme.sub-title: Follow the whimsical and absurd conversations of two friends and learn new things as they navigate life's everyday mysteries
programme.desc: ఇద్దరు స్నేహితుల విచిత్రమైన, మరియు అసంబద్ధమైన సంభాషణలను అనుసరించండి మరియు వారు జీవితంలోని కొత్త విషయాలను నేర్చుకోండి.

programme.title: పక్డమ్ పక్డై
programme.sub-title: There is a constant war between Doggy Don and the three clever mice who live in his house. However, with the help of Doggy Don's brother, an ex-army dog, they fight the mice to win back their house
programme.desc: తన ఇంట్లో మూడు ఎలుకలతో నిరంతరం యుద్ధం చేసే డాగీ డాన్, మాజీ ఆర్మీ కుక్కతో కలిసి తమ ఇంటిని సొంతం చేసుకోడానికి పోరాడతాడు.

programme.title: జిగ్ అండ్ షార్కో
programme.sub-title: Zig the hyena lives all alone on a desert island and schemes to eat Marina
programme.desc: జిగ్ అనే హైనా, మెరీనా అనే మత్స్యకన్యను తినడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది, కానీ ఆమె మిత్రుడు షార్కో ఆమెని జిగ్ నుండి కాపాడతాడు.

credits.director: Olivier Jean-Marie,Andrés Fernández,Cédric Dietsch,Khalil Ben Naamane,Yani Ouabdesselam,Nicolas Bougard,Pierre-Gilles Stehr

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ -ది భూత్ బంధుస్
programme.sub-title: Pinaki and his family of ghosts embark on spooky adventures and a series of fun and slapstick comedy as they try to fit in the outside world

programme.title: పాక్ పకావు
programme.sub-title: Follow the whimsical and absurd conversations of two friends and learn new things as they navigate life's everyday mysteries
programme.desc: ఇద్దరు స్నేహితుల విచిత్రమైన, మరియు అసంబద్ధమైన సంభాషణలను అనుసరించండి మరియు వారు జీవితంలోని కొత్త విషయాలను నేర్చుకోండి.

programme.title: పక్డమ్ పక్డై
programme.sub-title: There is a constant war between Doggy Don and the three clever mice who live in his house. However, with the help of Doggy Don's brother, an ex-army dog, they fight the mice to win back their house
programme.desc: తన ఇంట్లో మూడు ఎలుకలతో నిరంతరం యుద్ధం చేసే డాగీ డాన్, మాజీ ఆర్మీ కుక్కతో కలిసి తమ ఇంటిని సొంతం చేసుకోడానికి పోరాడతాడు.

programme.title: జిగ్ అండ్ షార్కో
programme.sub-title: Zig the hyena lives all alone on a desert island and schemes to eat Marina
programme.desc: జిగ్ అనే హైనా, మెరీనా అనే మత్స్యకన్యను తినడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది, కానీ ఆమె మిత్రుడు షార్కో ఆమెని జిగ్ నుండి కాపాడతాడు.

credits.director: Olivier Jean-Marie,Andrés Fernández,Cédric Dietsch,Khalil Ben Naamane,Yani Ouabdesselam,Nicolas Bougard,Pierre-Gilles Stehr

programme.title: పక్డమ్ పక్డాయి: ఎటాక్ ఆన్ టోక్యో
programme.sub-title: Facing his biggest battle yet, Doggy Don pairs up with Colonel to stand in the way of Samurai Gong, saving Tokyo from a disastrous attack
programme.desc: డాగీ డాన్, అతని అన్నయ్య కార్నెల్, జపాన్‌లోని టోక్యో నగరంలో విధ్వంసం సృష్టించాలనుకునే దుష్ట శక్తులతో పోరాడుతారు.

programme.title: జిగ్ అండ్ షార్కో
programme.sub-title: Zig the hyena lives all alone on a desert island and schemes to eat Marina

programme.title: భూత్ బంధుస్ అండ్ ద పవర్ ఆఫ్ త్రీ
programme.sub-title: A ghost family raises an abandoned baby boy, Pinaki, at the Vibhooti Mansion in the Modern City. Things take a humorous turn when he attends public school and gets exposed to the real world
programme.desc: విభూతి భవనంలో దెయ్యాల కుటుంబంలో పెరిగిన పినాకి, ప్రభుత్వ పాఠశాలలో చేరినప్పుడు వాస్తవ ప్రపంచాన్ని ఎదుర్కొంటాడు.

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ -ది భూత్ బంధుస్
programme.sub-title: Pinaki and his family of ghosts embark on spooky adventures and a series of fun and slapstick comedy as they try to fit in the outside world
programme.desc: పినాకి, అతని దెయ్యాల కుటుంబం బయటి ప్రపంచంలో ఇమిడిపోవడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తూ, భయానక సాహసాలు, హాస్య సంఘటనల పరంపరలో పయనిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Sonal Kaushal,Rajesh Kava,Manoj Pandey,Aranya Kaur,Pawan Kalra,Meghna Erande,Bhakti Jhaveri,Pooja Punjabi

programme.title: மங்கலத்வனி / நித்யபூஜலிவிகோ
programme.sub-title: An expert plays the shehnai at Tirumala temple, which is considered to be auspicious and a harbinger of good luck, in front of a group of devotees
programme.desc: திருமலை கோவிலில் ஷெனாயின் இசை இசைப்பது சுபகரமாக கருதப்படுவதினால் பக்தர்களின் ஒரு குழுவுக்கு முன் அதை இசைக்கும் நிபுணர்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம் லைவ்
programme.sub-title: Devotees sing a melodious rendition of 'Sri Venkateswara Suprabhatam', a hymn recited every morning at the Tirumala hill shrine, as a wake-up call for Lord Venkateswara, live
programme.desc: திருமலையில் தினமும் காலையில் வெங்கடேஸ்வரரை எழுப்ப ஓதப்படும் 'ஸ்ரீ வெங்கடேஸ்வர சுப்ரபாதம்' பாடலை பக்தர்கள் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: தோமால / கொலுவு லைவ்
programme.sub-title: Priests at the Tirumala temple perform a ceremony and adorn the deity with floral garlands; devotees showcase sacred figurines at their homes, live
programme.desc: திருமலை கோவிலில் மூல தெய்வத்தை மலர் மாலைகளால் அலங்கரிக்கப்படுகிறது; வீடுகளில் திருசிலைகளை காட்சிப்படுத்தும் பக்தர்கள்.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: చాలా ధైర్యవంతుడు, బలమైన, తెలివైన బాలుడు భీమ్, ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌ పట్టణవాసుల సమస్యలన్నింటినీ పరిష్కరించగలుగుతాడు.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: కొంటెవాడైన చిన్ని కృష్ణుడు, ప్రజలపైకి భయంకర రాక్షసులను పంపిన దుష్ట కంసుడి నుండి బృందావన ప్రజలను కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ మెడ్లీస్
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna has fun getting caught up in all sorts of mischief with his friends in Vrindavan. But when the evil Kansa sends his minions to disrupt his life, he jumps into action
programme.desc: బృందావనంలో తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి అల్లరి చేస్తూ సరదాగా తిరిగే శ్రీకృష్ణుడు, కంసుడి రాక్షసులను అంతం చేయడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: గ్రిజ్జీ అండ్ ద లెమ్మింగ్స్
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్జీ అనే ఎలుగుబంటి ఒక అటవీ రేంజర్ ఇంటిని తన సొంత నివాసంగా భావిస్తుంది, అయితే లెమ్మింగ్స్ రాకతో పరిస్థితి మారుతుంది.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.sub-title: Follow the hilarious misadventures of Sampat and Champat, two bumbling thieves who constantly hatch chaotic plans that backfire, landing them in endless trouble with the local police

programme.title: ఓమి నెం.1
programme.sub-title: Omi, an ultra-rich nine-year-old heir, encounters hilarious and eye-opening situations that teach him about the realities of life

programme.title: గ్రిజ్జీ అండ్ ద లెమ్మింగ్స్

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: జై జగన్నాథ్
programme.sub-title: The host shines light on the annual chariot procession held in the honour of Lord Jagannath in Puri, Odisha, which is attended by numerous devotees from all over the country
programme.desc: ఒడిశాలోని పూరీలో జగన్నాథ స్వామి గౌరవార్థం జరిగే వార్షిక రథోత్సవంపై వివరిస్తారు, దేశం నలుమూలల నుండి భక్తులు హాజరవుతారు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం
programme.sub-title: Little Singham, an honest but ferocious police officer, fights against injustice and defends his town from formidable enemies
programme.desc: నిజాయితీపరుడైన పోలీసు అధికారి లిటిల్ సింగం అన్యాయానికి వ్యతిరేకంగా పోరాడుతూ, శత్రువుల నుండి తన పట్టణాన్ని కాపాడతాడు.

programme.title: గ్రిజ్జీ అండ్ ద లెమ్మింగ్స్
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్జీ అనే ఎలుగుబంటి ఒక అటవీ రేంజర్ ఇంటిని తన సొంత నివాసంగా భావిస్తుంది, అయితే లెమ్మింగ్స్ రాకతో పరిస్థితి మారుతుంది.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: సంపత్ చంపత్
programme.sub-title: Follow the hilarious misadventures of Sampat and Champat, two bumbling thieves who constantly hatch chaotic plans that backfire, landing them in endless trouble with the local police
programme.desc: సంపత్, చంపత్ అనే ఇద్దరు చేతకాని దొంగలు నిరంతరం స్థానిక పోలీసుల చిక్కుల్లో పడే హాస్యభరితమైన సాహసాలను అనుసరించండి.

programme.title: మైటీ లిటిల్ భీమ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem, an affectionate toddler, has many adventures with his little friends and loving family. Every day he learns something new as he grows taller
programme.desc: తన స్నేహితులు, ప్రేమగల కుటుంబంతో కలిసి అనేక సాహసాలు చేసే పసిబిడ్డ భీమ్, పెరిగే కొద్దీ ఏదో ఒక కొత్త విషయం నేర్చుకుంటాడు.

programme.desc: This wildlife documentary follows Hugh Fearnley-Whittingstall and a team of experts as they travel across seas to find the world's most extraordinary animal stories. The series focuses on animal intelligence, exploring remarkable behaviours, relationships and actions of various species. programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: Whether the protagonist is a Batsquatch, Skunk Ape, Mothman or Chupacabra, tales of mysterious creatures and unexplainable phenomena have been passed down generations. \"Monsters and Mysteries in America\" takes a trip across the U.S. to reveal the most cryptic, frightening and brow-furrowing stories. Each hourlong episode focuses on a specific region and the lore of residents who claim to have encountered legendary monsters, ancient spirits or alien beings. With America's dense forests, desert grasslands, and hundreds of miles of uninhabitable wilderness, could it really house -- or hide -- so many mysterious creatures?

programme.title: The Prosecutors: In Pursuit of Justice
programme.desc: Real-life criminal cases prosecuted by attorneys.

programme.desc: TV host Lindsey Granger, filmmaker Kolyn Boyd, and their young daughter, Kynsley, embark on adventures, discovering eateries, unique stays and experiencing various international cultures.

programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: The marriage vow \"till death do us part\" lives up to its promise for the couples featured in \"Happily Never After.\" It's a wedding show and police drama rolled into one, as the best days in the lives of brides and grooms tragically turn when homicides crash the honeymoons. Each episode tells the true story -- narrated by actress Marlo Thomas -- of a newlywed's murder, interspersed with flashbacks to happier days for the couple. Dr. Wendy Walsh, who holds a Ph.D. in clinical psychology and is a co-host on the syndicated program \"The Doctors,\" offers commentary on the behavioral twists and turns in each story.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dan Short fell in love with cars when he first laid eyes on a 1967 Camaro. He bought a used model as a teenager, but because he couldn't pay someone else to restore it, he learned how to do the work himself. After a stint in the Army, Short decided to make his passion for classic cars his life's work, and FantomWorks was born. Today the Norfolk, Va., company is the largest auto restoration shop in the U.S., and this reality series shows how Short and his team meticulously refurbish some of America's favorite rides. Drama ensues in the form of personality clashes, cost overruns, irate customers and other issues, which are compounded by Short's reputation as a straight shooter who won't accept substandard results.

programme.title: बब्लू डबलू
programme.sub-title: An evil logger decides to turn the forest into his personal lumberyard. However, things change after Bablu and Dablu, two bear brothers, decide to stop him
programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments
programme.desc: एक मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला मुर्गा अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है, जहां वे चुनौतियों पर विजय प्राप्त करते हैं और दिल को छू लेने वाले पल साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: मद्दाम सर
programme.sub-title: Four brave female police officers of Aminabad police station use their wittiness and emotional intelligence to tackle the various challenges they face at their work

programme.title: गुरु और भोले
programme.sub-title: Two close friends, Guru and Bhole, live in the quaint little town of Surtaal Nagar in North India. They always end up in sticky situations but have a musical adventure while trying to get out of it
programme.desc: दो जिगरी दोस्त गुरु और भोले, उत्तर भारत के एक अनोखे और पुराने छोटे शहर, सुर-ताल नगर में रहते हैं। वे अक्सर किसी न किसी मुसीबत में फँस जाते हैं लेकिन साहसिक कारनामे करते हुए उनसे बहार निकल आते हैं।.

programme.desc: Two bears go through epic adventures and come up with various ways to stop an evil logger from destroying their forest home.

programme.title: हनी बनी व़ाइटी

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments
programme.desc: एक मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला मुर्गा अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है, जहां वे चुनौतियों पर विजय प्राप्त करते हैं और दिल को छू लेने वाले पल साझा करते हैं।.

programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: टेलीशॉपिंग
programme.sub-title: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home

programme.title: मद्दाम सर
programme.sub-title: Four brave female police officers of Aminabad police station use their wittiness and emotional intelligence to tackle the various challenges they face at their work
programme.desc: अमीनाबाद पुलिस स्टेशन की चार बहादुर महिला पुलिस अधिकारी अपने कार्यस्थल की विभिन्न चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए अपनी बुद्धिमता और भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता का उपयोग करती हैं।.

programme.title: गुरु और भोले
programme.sub-title: Two close friends, Guru and Bhole, live in the quaint little town of Surtaal Nagar in North India. They always end up in sticky situations but have a musical adventure while trying to get out of it
programme.desc: दो जिगरी दोस्त गुरु और भोले, उत्तर भारत के एक अनोखे और पुराने छोटे शहर, सुर-ताल नगर में रहते हैं। वे अक्सर किसी न किसी मुसीबत में फँस जाते हैं लेकिन साहसिक कारनामे करते हुए उनसे बहार निकल आते हैं।.

programme.title: बब्लू डब्लू एमपी
programme.desc: Two bears go through epic adventures and come up with various ways to stop an evil logger from destroying their forest home.

programme.title: हनी बनी व़ाइटी
programme.sub-title: Honey and Bunny, two pet cats, engage in various adventures with other pets when Miss Katkar, their owner, goes out of the house
programme.desc: दो पालतू बिल्लियाँ हनी और बनी, जब उनकी मालकिन मिस काटकर घर से बाहर जाती हैं, तो वे अन्य पालतू जानवरों के साथ कई तरह के रोमांच में शामिल हो जाती हैं।.

programme.title: जंगल बुक
programme.sub-title: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli

programme.sub-title: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli
programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.title: बब्लू डबलू
programme.sub-title: An evil logger decides to turn the forest into his personal lumberyard. However, things change after Bablu and Dablu, two bear brothers, decide to stop him
programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.desc: अमीनाबाद पुलिस स्टेशन की चार बहादुर महिला पुलिस अधिकारी अपने कार्यस्थल की विभिन्न चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए अपनी बुद्धिमता और भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता का उपयोग करती हैं।.

programme.title: जीजा जी छत पर है
programme.sub-title: Elaichi's mischievous antics keep her father Murari on edge, while Pancham, secretly in love with her, navigates hilarious mishaps due to his hidden marital status
programme.desc: इलायची की शरारतें उसके पिता मुरारी को परेशान रखती हैं, जबकि पंचम, जो मन ही मन इलायची से प्यार करता है, अपनी छुपी हुई वैवाहिक स्थिति के कारण हास्यास्पद घटनाओं से गुजरता है।.

programme.title: கால பைரவன்

programme.title: மூவி

credits.actor: Sivakumar,Radikaa Sarathkumar,Shyam Ganesh,Kuyili,Ponvannan,Viji Chandrasekhar,Shanmuga Sundaram,Jyothi Lakshmi

programme.title: Maharathi
programme.desc: After his boss, Jai Singh, commits suicide, Subhash, a chauffeur, conspires to get his insurance money. He then teams up with Jai's wife, Mallika, to make the suicide look like a well-planned murder.

programme.title: बेमिसाल
programme.sub-title: A young Sudhir is adopted by Mr Chaturvedi and develops a strong bond with his son, Prashant. Later, when the police arrest Prashant for performing illegal abortions, Sudhir comes to his rescue
programme.desc: चतुर्वेदी, युवा सुधीर को गोद लेता है और वह उसके बेटे प्रशांत के साथ गहरा बंधन बनाता है। जब पुलिस, प्रशांत को अवैध तरीके से गर्भपात करने के लिए गिरफ्तार करती है, तो सुधीर उसका बचाव करता है।.

credits.actor: Amitabh Bachchan (Dr. Sudhir Roy / Adhir Roy),Vinod Mehra (Dr. Prashant Chaturvedi),Rakhee Gulzar (Kavita Chaturvedi),A. K. programme.title: मेरा दामाद
programme.sub-title: Jai's father asks him to meet Sunita before getting married to her. However, complications arise when Jai falls in love with Kimi, while on his way to Sunita's village
programme.desc: जय के पिता उससे शादी करने से पहले सुनीता से मिलने के लिए कहते हैं। हालाँकि, मुश्किलें तब पैदा होती हैं जब सुनीता के गाँव जाते समय जय को किरी से प्यार हो जाता है।.

credits.actor: Farooq Shaikh (Jai Khanna),Zarina Wahab (Kimi/Sunita),Ashok Kumar (Barrister Ajit Khanna),Utpal Dutt (Sitanath Chaudhary),Rakesh Bedi (Ravi),Prema Narayan (Shalu),Brahmachari,Master Bhagwan,Jankidas (Shalu's Bapu)

programme.title: आप आये बहार आयी
programme.sub-title: Kumar and Rohit, who are childhood friends, soon turn enemies when Kumar molests Rohit's fiancée out of jealousy. She feels unworthy of Rohit and calls off the wedding
programme.desc: कुमार और रोहित, जो बचपन के दोस्त हैं, लेकिन कुमार, ईर्ष्या में रोहित की मंगेतर के साथ छेड़छाड़ करता है। वह इससे बहुत घृणित महसूस करती है और शादी तोड़ देती है।.

credits.actor: Rajendra Kumar,Sadhana,Prem Chopra,Rajendranath,Raj Mehra,Mumtaz Begum,Meena T.

programme.title: साथ साथ
programme.sub-title: Gita, a girl from a wealthy family, falls in love with an idealistic Avinash who has stern principles in life. However, his changed behaviour post marriage troubles her
programme.desc: गीता, एक धनी परिवार की लड़की, एक आदर्शवादी अविनाश से प्यार करती है, जो कट्टर सिद्धांतवादी हैं। हालांकि, विवाह के बाद उसके बदले हुए व्यवहार के कारण गीता परेशान होती है।.

credits.actor: Deepti Naval,Farooq Shaikh,Satish Shah,Iftekhar,A. K. Hangal,Sudha Chopra

programme.title: ख़ुदा गवाह
programme.sub-title: Badshah Khan travels to India to behead the man who killed Benazir's father and win her hand in marriage. He succeeds in his mission but is caught by Ranveer Singh, a jailer
programme.desc: बादशाह खान बेनज़ीर के पिता के हत्यारे को खोजने के लिए भारत यात्रा करता है जिससे वह उसे प्रभावित कर सके। वह सफल होता है लेकिन जल्द ही एक हत्या के आरोप में खुद को भारतीय जेल में पाता है।.

credits.actor: Amitabh Bachchan (Baadshah Khan),Sridevi (Benazir / Mehndi),Nagarjuna (Inspector Raja Mirza),Shilpa Shirodkar (Inspector Heena),Danny Denzongpa (Khuda Baksh),Kiran Kumar (Pasha),Bharat Kapoor (Aziz Mirza),Anjana Mumtaz (Salma Mirza),Vikram Gokhale (Ranveer Sikhri),Beena Banerjee (Ranveer Sikhri's Wife)

programme.title: गैर कानूनी
programme.sub-title: Police Inspector Kapil Khanna realises that his baby boy has been switched with a girl child by the hospital and files a lawsuit against the owner, Robert Decosta, while trying to find his missing son
programme.desc: अधिकारी कपिल, बदमाश, डी'कोस्टा के खिलाफ सबूत हासिल करने के लिए अंडरवर्ल्ड, आज़म की मदद लेता है। जब आज़म को मार डाला जाता है,उसका बेटा,अकबर, कपिल को जिम्मेदार ठहराता है और प्रतिशोध लेता है।.

programme.title: भूमिका - द रोल
programme.sub-title: Urvashi who becomes an actress with the help of Keshav, ends up marrying him. However, things complicate when she indulges in affairs with prominent men in the film industry
programme.desc: केशव की मदद से अभिनेत्री बनी उर्वशी उससे शादी कर लेती है। हालाँकि, चीजें तब जटिल हो जाती हैं जब वह फिल्म उद्योग के प्रमुख व्यक्तियों के साथ संबंधों में शामिल हो जाती है।.

credits.actor: Smita Patil,Anant Nag,Amrish Puri,Naseeruddin Shah,Salubha Deshpande,Kulbhushan Kharbanda,B.V. Karanth,Amol Palekar

programme.title: फ़िराक
programme.sub-title: In the aftermath of Gujarat's violent 2002 riots, victims find their lives changed forever and reel from the deep impact the upheaval left on them
programme.desc: यह फ़िल्म, 2002 में गुजरात में हुए दंगों में कुछ आम लोगों के भावनात्मक अनुभव के बारे में है, जिसमें कुछ पीड़ित, कुछ दोषी व्यक्ति और कुछ चुपचाप तमाशा देखने वाले लोग भी शामिल हैं।.

credits.actor: Tisca Chopra,Shahana Goswami,Deepti Naval,Paresh Rawal,Naseeruddin Shah,Sanjay Suri,Raghuvir Yadav

programme.title: युद्ध
programme.sub-title: A policeman sacrifices his life protecting Savitri and her twins from a gangster. Savitri raises the fallen officer's son as her twins, now separated, grow into a lawyer and a sniper
programme.desc: सावित्री और उसके जुड़वाँ बच्चों को एक गैंगस्टर से बचाने की कोशिश में एक पुलिस की मौत होती है। वह पुलिस के बेटे की परवरिश करती है, और उसके एक बेटे की परवरिश वकील और अन्य की अपहरणकर्ता द्वारा होती है।.

credits.actor: Anil Kapoor,Tina Munim,Jackie Shroff,Danny Denzongpa,Nutan,Deven Verma,Hema Malini,Shatrughan Sinha

programme.title: Surkhaab
programme.sub-title: Jeet, a former judo champion, decides to travel to Canada in search of employment. However, since she has no money, she seeks the help of a local man who ends up cheating her
programme.desc: Si Jeet, isang dating kampeon ng judo, ay naglalakbay sa Canada upang maghanap ng trabaho. Dahil wala siyang pera, humihingi siya ng tulong sa isang trafficker na lolokohin siya.

credits.actor: Barkha Madan,Sumit Suri,Nishant Bahl,Kanza Feris,Naresh Gosain,Vineeta Malik,Reza Sholeh,Ashu Sharma

programme.title: अवतार
programme.sub-title: Avatar leads a happy life with his wife, Radha, and his sons, Chander and Ramesh. However, consumed by their greed and ambitions, Avatar's sons betray him, but he soon reaches new heights of success
programme.desc: अवतार के बेटे उसे और उसकी पत्नी को उनके हाल पर छोड़ देते हैं। हालाँकि, अपने बेटों द्वारा बेदखल किए जाने पर अवतार सफलता की नई ऊँचाईयों पर पहुँचता है।.

credits.actor: Rajesh Khanna,Shabana Azmi,Madan Puri,Sujit Kumar,A. K. Hangal,Sachin,Gulshan Grover

programme.title: इंटरनेशनल क्रूक
programme.sub-title: Rajesh, the superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend, Shekar, in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler, who is involved in a spree of illegal activities
programme.desc: एक पुलिस अधीक्षक, राजेश गोवा में अपने पुराने दोस्त, शेखर से मिलता है। लेकिन,उसे शेखर तस्कर है और अवैध गतिविधियों में शामिल हैं, यह जरासा भी पता नही है।.

credits.actor: Dharmendra,Feroz Khan,Saira Banu,Om Prakash,Sulochana Chatterjee,Murad,Jagdish Raj,Jagdeep,Jayshree T.,Sunder

programme.title: मासूम
programme.sub-title: D K Malhotra leads a peaceful life with his wife and two daughters. But all of this changes when he is forced to bring a boy, who is his son from a previous relationship, home after his mother dies
programme.desc: एक पारिवारिक व्यक्ति का जीवन बदलता है, जब उसे पता चलता है कि उसका एक नाजायज बेटा है। बच्चे की माँ मरणासन्न के दौरान, उसे उसके पिता के साथ रहने के लिए भेजती है।.

credits.actor: Naseeruddin Shah,Shabana Azmi,Supriya Pathak,Jugal Hansraj,Urmila,Saeed Jaffrey,Ram Gopal Bajaj,Satish Kaushik,Aziz Qureshi,Pran Talwar,Tanuja

programme.title: घर संसार
programme.sub-title: When Prakash's father dies, he is forced to shoulder the financial responsibilities of his large family. However, his troubles increase when his younger brother leaves him home to join a gang
programme.desc: प्रकाश को अपने पिता के आकस्मिक मृत्यु के बाद पूरे परिवार की ज़िम्मेदारी का ख्याल रखना होगा। उसका छोटा भाई चंदन लगातार उसके विवाहित जीवन को बर्बाद करने की कोशिश करता है।.

programme.title: अलबेला
programme.sub-title: A woman gets stuck in India when her flight to a foreign country gets delayed. While travelling in India, she meets Tony, a tour guide, and things take a turn when he falls in love with her
programme.desc: एक टूर गाइड, टोनी अपनी एक ग्राहक,सोनिया से प्यार होता है और उसे लुभाने की कोशिश करता है। हालांकि, सोनिया उसे स्विकार नहीं करती क्योंकि वह किसी अन्य व्यक्ति से प्यार करती है।.

credits.actor: Jackie Shroff (Prem),Govinda (Tony),Aishwarya Rai (Sonia),Namrata Shirodkar (Nina),Sanjay Mishra (Gabru),Saeed Jaffrey (Sonia's father),Johnny Lever,Maya Alagh (Nanny),Dinyar Tirandaz (Firoz)

programme.title: घर एक मन्दिर
programme.sub-title: Brothers Prem, Vijay and Ravi are happy, but their lives change when Prem gets killed. Ravi must save his family from an evil man, Dharampal, while Vijay is preoccupied with Sapna
programme.desc: प्रेम, विजय और रवि अपने घर को प्यार का मंदिर मानते हैं। हालाँकि, उनका जीवन बदलता है, जब प्रेम की हत्या होती है और विजय, सपना के प्यार में अंधा हो जाता है।.

programme.title: दुलारा
programme.sub-title: Falsely accused of murder, Raja becomes a target for Vijay, a police inspector and his lover's brother. In a bid to end his misery and catch the real culprit, Raja sets out on a mission
programme.desc: प्रिया का भाई इ. विजय जानता है कि उसके प्रेमी राजा के पिता ने दो महिलाओं की हत्या की है. क्या राजा भी इस ह्त्या का दोषी है?

programme.title: साजन की सहेली
programme.sub-title: Kunti abandons her baby in order to lead a lavish life and marries a rich man. Years later, she realises that her husband is indulging in an affair and is shocked to find out the truth about the girl
programme.desc: एक शानदार जीवन जीने और अमीर आदमी से शादी करने कुंती अपने बच्ची को छोड़ देती है।सालों बाद,उसे पता चलता है कि उसके पति का किसी लड़की के साथ अवैध संबंध है लेकिन लड़की के बारे में जानने के बाद हैरान होती है।.

credits.actor: Nutan,Rajendra Kumar,Rekha,Vinod Mehra,Suresh Oberoi,Paintal,Anil Dhawan,Kalpana Iyer

programme.title: गुप्त
programme.sub-title: After his stepfather is murdered, Sahil gets arrested, but he manages to escape prison to prove his innocence. However, Inspector Udham Singh sets off to capture him
programme.desc: साहिल पर अपने सौतेले पिता की हत्या का आरोप लगता है लेकिन वह अपनी बेगुनाही साबित करने का निश्चय करता है। साहिल, शीतल की मदद से जेल से फरार होता है, हालांकि एक बहादुर पुलिसकर्मी उसकी तलाश में है।.

programme.title: లా విడా ఎన్ ఎల్ ఆఫ్రికా ఆర్డియంటే
programme.sub-title: Many species that live in extreme places slow down their cycles of reproduction and breeding. Wild dogs speed up the process by several weeks to avoid having to expose their pups to the dangers of heat
programme.desc: The threat of climate change is especially a risk for those living in the world's hottest regions, such as the Namib, the Kalahari and the Kaokoveld in the southern cone of Africa.

programme.title: సర్వైవింగ్ ఎర్త్
programme.sub-title: A matriarch elephant leads her herd on a journey to find water, encountering an alien continent where they must adapt to a new way of life to survive
programme.desc: An eight-part docuseries exploring Earth's major eras and extinction events across 450 million years alongside the creatures who fought to survive.

programme.title: గ్యాంగ్స్ ఆఫ్ బబూన్ ఫాల్స్
programme.sub-title: As lockdown continues, the streets of Victoria Falls have become eerily deserted, and the gangs must now figure out new ways to survive in a dramatically changed world
programme.desc: జింబాబ్వే, జాంబియా సరిహద్దులో నాలుగు చక్మా బబూల్ బృందాలు ఆహారం, ప్రాతీయ అధికారాల కోసం ఒకదానితో మరొకటి పోటీపడతాయి.

programme.title: గ్యాంగ్స్ ఆఫ్ బబూన్ ఫాల్స్
programme.sub-title: As the Victoria gang struggle with lots of new mouths to feed, another troop must decide whether to let outcasts from outer town in
programme.desc: జింబాబ్వే, జాంబియా సరిహద్దులో నాలుగు చక్మా బబూల్ బృందాలు ఆహారం, ప్రాతీయ అధికారాల కోసం ఒకదానితో మరొకటి పోటీపడతాయి.

programme.title: ద లాస్ట్ రెఫ్యూజ్
programme.sub-title: In the Philippines, Aeta tribesmen battle industrial encroachment on ancestral lands
programme.desc: దర్శకులు రిఫ్ట్ వ్యాలీ పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థ సంవత్సరాలుగా ఎలా అభివృద్ధి చెందిందో, జంతువుల స్థితిస్థాపకతను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: డెడ్లీయెస్ట్ సౌతాఫ్రికా
programme.sub-title: Kurt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's 12 most deadly snakes
programme.desc: కుర్డ్ గ్రీన్‌వుడ్, దక్షిణాఫ్రికాలోని ప్రాణాంతకమైన పన్నెండు రకాల పాములను అన్వేషిస్తూ, వాటి గురించి అవగాహన కలిగిస్తారు.

programme.title: స్నో లెపర్డ్స్ విత్ డాన్ ఓనీల్‌
programme.sub-title: Navigating the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan O'Neill as he searches for 'The Dude', the largest snow leopard ever recorded
programme.desc: ప్రకృతి, జీవ శాస్త్రవేత్త అయిన డాన్ ఓనీల్, ఒక పరిశోధనా కేంద్రాన్ని నిర్మించి, మంచు చిరుతపులిపై అధ్యయనం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: ఆసీ స్నేక్ రాంగ్లర్స్
programme.sub-title: Chris and Jess head to the outskirts of Sydney, Australia, to capture an elusive red-bellied black snake; a coastal carpet python needs help out of a drainpipe; Stuart and Olivia make a rare find
programme.desc: ఆస్ట్రేలియన్ ఇళ్లలో చొరబడిన ప్రాణాంతకమైన పాములను పట్టుకునే క్రమంలో నిపుణులు ప్రమాదకర పరిస్థితులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

programme.title: ఆసీ స్నేక్ రాంగ్లర్స్
programme.sub-title: Chris and Stu come face-to-face with a giant red-bellied black snake that's taking shelter in a car's engine. In South Australia, Mick and Adele are helping local snake catcher, Dan, with one of his busiest snake catching seasons on record
programme.desc: ఆస్ట్రేలియన్ ఇళ్లలో చొరబడిన ప్రాణాంతకమైన పాములను పట్టుకునే క్రమంలో నిపుణులు ప్రమాదకర పరిస్థితులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

programme.title: సీక్రెట్స్ ఆఫ్ ది ఫ్లడెడ్ ఫారెస్ట్
programme.sub-title: The biological cycle of Abruzzi's chamois, which are endemic to the highest mountains of Central Italy. The Apennine chamois are an ancient species, but today, they are under serious threat. They are the survivors of a prehistoric species
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు డానుబే నదీతీర అడవుల పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థలో అభివృద్ధి చెందుతున్న ప్రత్యేకమైన వన్యప్రాణుల రూపాన్ని అందించారు.

programme.title: చైనాస్ వైల్డ్ సీక్రెట్స్
programme.sub-title: In southwestern China, towering mountains provide shelter for nearly 2,000 wild giant pandas. Giant Panda National Park is three times the size of Yellowstone and is home to over 10,000 species
programme.desc: Spanning five of China's hidden wildlife havens, exploring some of the world's most diverse ecosystems. From lush rainforests to soaring mountains, we uncover never-before-seen animal behaviours.

programme.title: చైనాస్ వైల్డ్ సీక్రెట్స్
programme.sub-title: There aren't many rainforests in China, but Hainan Island, known as China's Hawaii, is an exception. The island's isolation for millions of years has allowed unique species to develop
programme.desc: Spanning five of China's hidden wildlife havens, exploring some of the world's most diverse ecosystems. From lush rainforests to soaring mountains, we uncover never-before-seen animal behaviours.

programme.title: చైనాస్ వైల్డ్ సీక్రెట్స్
programme.sub-title: At the Roof of the World, we find the sources of three great rivers: the Huang He, the Yangtze, and the Mekong. These rich waterways allow genetically unique species to flourish
programme.desc: Spanning five of China's hidden wildlife havens, exploring some of the world's most diverse ecosystems. From lush rainforests to soaring mountains, we uncover never-before-seen animal behaviours.

programme.title: ఫియర్ ఆన్ ది సవన్నా
programme.sub-title: Authorities introduced lions in a rehabilitated national park where only herbivores lived, and fear overtook the park
programme.desc: కేవలం శాకాహారులు మాత్రమే నివసించే పునరుద్ధరించబడిన జాతీయ ఉద్యానవనంలో అధికారులు సింహాలను ప్రవేశపెట్టడంతో, ఆ పార్కులో భయం ఆవరిస్తుంది.

programme.title: డాగ్స్ ఇన్ ద ల్యాండ్ ఆఫ్ లయన్స్
programme.sub-title: We follow the unforgettable journey of a family of wild dogs in Zimbabwe and witness rarely seen behaviour, from tender moments with newborn pups, to the thrills of hunting wildebeest, to close encounters with their greatest enemy - the lion
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు, జింబాబ్వేలోని అడవి కుక్కల అసాధారణ ప్రయాణాన్ని అనుసరిస్తూ, అవి వేటాడే సమయంలో సున్నితమైన క్షణాలను సంగ్రహిస్తారు.

programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures - from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles - in `Natural Born Monsters'. When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: Fight For Life

programme.title: ద జూ
programme.sub-title: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు అంతరించిపోతున్న జాతులను రక్షించడంలో, వన్యప్రాణులను సంరక్షించడానికి బ్రాంక్స్ జూ చేస్తున్న ప్రయత్నాలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: సర్వైవింగ్ ఎర్త్
programme.desc: From the producers of Walking with Dinosaurs comes an eight-part docuseries spanning 450 million years that revisits eight of Earth's major extinction events. Bringing some of the planet's most extraordinary geological eras to vivid life, the all-new footage created in partnership with real scientific insight explores the lives of animals we know and love, including mammoths, saber-toothed cats and dinosaurs, alongside some of evolution's truly unique creatures, like gorgonopsians, pliosaurs, glyptotherium and more. Together, they tell the story of how life has endured the impossible -- and never stopped fighting for survival.

programme.sub-title: As the Victoria gang struggles with a lot of new mouths to feed, the Zambia troops contemplate whether they can afford to take in outcasts from another town

programme.desc: జింబాబ్వే, జాంబియా సరిహద్దులో నాలుగు చక్మా బబూల్ బృందాలు ఆహారం, ప్రాతీయ అధికారాల కోసం ఒకదానితో మరొకటి పోటీపడతాయి.

programme.title: డెడ్లీయెస్ట్ సౌతాఫ్రికా
programme.sub-title: Kurt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's twelve most deadly snakes, as well as to educate and inspire people to see the value of these often misunderstood creatures
programme.desc: కుర్డ్ గ్రీన్‌వుడ్, దక్షిణాఫ్రికాలోని ప్రాణాంతకమైన పన్నెండు రకాల పాములను అన్వేషిస్తూ, వాటి గురించి అవగాహన కలిగిస్తారు.

programme.title: లయన్స్ వర్సెస్ హైనాస్
programme.sub-title: Wildlife experts offer detailed insights into lionesses and hyenas nursing their young and teaching them how to adapt to the wild
programme.desc: చిత్రదర్శకుడు ఎన్నో ఏళ్లుగా ప్రజలు తప్పుగా అర్థం చేసుంటున్న సింహాలు, హైనాల మధ్య జరిగే సంఘర్షణ గురించి చూపుతారు.

programme.title: స్నో లెపర్డ్స్ విత్ డాన్ ఓనీల్‌
programme.sub-title: Prowl the heart of Central Asia with biologist and naturalist Dan O'Neill as he races against time searching for the enigmatic snow leopard
programme.desc: ప్రకృతి, జీవ శాస్త్రవేత్త అయిన డాన్ ఓనీల్, ఒక పరిశోధనా కేంద్రాన్ని నిర్మించి, మంచు చిరుతపులిపై అధ్యయనం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: Fight For Life
programme.desc: Discover the story of the rehabilitation of an African national park. After the first step of successfully acclimatising herbivores, it is time to reintroduce lions. But with them comes predation, and suddenly, fear overtakes the park.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్స్ స్మాల్ వరల్డ్
programme.sub-title: During a spring season on the Gomoti River, mothers take charge as they train their young ones essential survival skills to thrive in the wild
programme.desc: మూడు పెద్ద పిల్లి కుటుంబాలు ఉమ్మడి స్థలంలో సహజీవనం చేస్తూనే ప్రత్యర్థులను అధిగమించడానికి వారి నైపుణ్యాలను ఉపయోగిస్తాయి.

programme.title: సీక్రెట్స్ ఆఫ్ ది ఫ్లడెడ్ ఫారెస్ట్
programme.sub-title: Surviving the vast mountains of Italy, the chamois are an endemic group of species that are facing a series threat of extinction
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు డానుబే నదీతీర అడవుల పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థలో అభివృద్ధి చెందుతున్న ప్రత్యేకమైన వన్యప్రాణుల రూపాన్ని అందించారు.

programme.title: టెక్సాస్ గేటర్ సేవర్స్
programme.sub-title: Gary, Arlie and Jake seek an alligator within an RV site while Shannon discovers a venomous serpent at a nearby firm. Consequently, the group exchanges reptiles with their sibling facility
programme.desc: గ్యారీ సౌరేజ్, అతని బృందం వివిధ అసాధారణ ప్రదేశాలలోని మొసళ్ళను రక్షించి, కొత్త వాతావరణంలో వాటి సంక్షేమానికి తోడ్పడతారు.

programme.title: ఐబీరియన్ వైపర్స్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the behaviour, characteristics and survival strategies of venomous vipers that inhabit the Iberian Peninsula
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ఐబీరియన్ ద్వీపకల్పంలో నివసించే అత్యంత విషపూరితమైన వైపర్‌ల ప్రవర్తన, లక్షణాలు, మనుగడ వ్యూహాలను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: టైగ్రెస్ బ్లడ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the lives of four tigresses in Central India who are rewriting the rules of how a tiger pack survives and hunts
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు మధ్య భారతదేశంలోని నాలుగు పులుల జీవితాలను అన్వేషించారు, అవి పులి ప్యాక్ ఎలా జీవించి వేటాడుతుంది.

programme.title: న్యాచురల్ బార్న్ మాన్‌స్టర్స్
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures -- from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles -- in \"Natural Born Monsters.\" When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: Turtle Walker
programme.desc: The life of Satish Bhaskar, an Indian conservationist who dedicated himself to studying and protecting endangered sea turtles along India's coasts in the 1970s, and explores the aftermath of the 2004 tsunami on their habitats.

programme.title: యానిమల్ ఎటాక్ రేట్

programme.sub-title: A young university student's world is rocked when her brief involvement with a wealthy playboy results in her pregnancy

programme.title: सौतन
programme.sub-title: Shyam, a middle-class man, falls in love with a millionaire's daughter and marries her. However, as their relationship starts deteriorating, Shyam finds solace in the company of Radha
programme.desc: एक मध्यम वर्गीय व्यक्ति, श्याम, अमीर रुक्मिणी से प्यार करता है और उससे शादी करता है। हालांकि, श्याम और राधा के रिश्ते में खटास बढ़ने पर, उसकी राधा से नज़दीकियाँ बढ़ जाती हैं।.

credits.actor: Rajesh Khanna,Tina Munim,Padmini Kolhapure,Prem Chopra,Shashikala,Pran,Shreeram Lagoo

programme.title: फिलर
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविज़न के एक से बढ़कर एक कार्यक्रमों को प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: इनकार
programme.sub-title: When Maya accuses Rahul, her CEO and mentor at the advertising agency, of sexual harassment, a committee is formed to offer them a platform to share their perspectives
programme.desc: एक विज्ञापन एजेंसी के सीईओ, राहुल पर उसकी आश्रित, माया यौन उत्पीड़न का आरोप लगाती है। लेकिन जल्द ही, समिति कदम उठाती है और उन दोनों को अपना अपना पक्ष स्पष्ट करने का मौका देती है।.

programme.title: जय विक्रांत
programme.sub-title: Driven by a solemn vow, Vikraanta seeks vengeance against the ruthless landlord responsible for his father's brutal murder
programme.desc: ग्रामीण भारत के एक गरीब, ईमानदार किसान की एक लालची जमींदार द्वारा हत्या कर दी जाती है, तब उसका बेटा विक्रांत उसकी हत्या का बदला लेने की कसम खाता है।.

credits.actor: Sanjay Dutt,Reema Lagoo,Zeba Bakhtiar,Amrish Puri,Mukesh Khanna,Shahbaaz Khan,Suresh Oberoi,Deepti Naval

programme.title: दिल का रिश्ता
programme.sub-title: Jai, a wealthy businessman in love with Tia, accidentally kills her husband in a car crash. After the accident Tia loses her memory and falls for Jai, who struggles with guilt
programme.desc: टिया से प्यार करने वाला एक अमीर व्यापारी जय, गलती से एक कार दुर्घटना में उसके पति को मार देता है। दुर्घटना के बाद टिया की याददाश्त खो जाती है और जय से प्यार करने लगती है, जो अपराधबोध से जूझता है।.

credits.actor: Aishwarya Rai (Tia Sharma),Arjun Rampal (Jai Mehta),Priyanshu Chatterjee (Raj),Raakhee (Mrinalini Sharma),Isha Koppikar (Anita),Paresh Rawal (Harshavardhan Mehta),Tiku Talsania (Swamy),Hitanshu Lodhia (Anshu)

programme.title: हलचल
programme.sub-title: A man and a woman come from two feuding families and pretend to be in love for revenge. Their plan goes awry when they fall in love, and they must work on bringing together their families
programme.desc: शत्रुतापूर्ण दो परिवार से अंजलि और जय केवल बदला लेने के लिए प्यार में होने का नाटक करते है। उनकी योजना गड़बड़ा जाती है जब उन्हें सच में प्यार होता हैं और वे परिवारो को एक साथ लाने की कोशिश करते हैं।.

programme.title: सलाखें
programme.sub-title: An honest schoolteacher commits suicide due to the actions of the family of a man he testified against. In retaliation, his son takes the law into his own hands and seeks revenge
programme.desc: विशाल के पिता एक शक्तिशाली आदमी के बेटे के खिलाफ गवाही देनेवाले है जिससे उनको परेशान किया जाता है। दोषपूर्ण न्यायिक प्रणाली और भ्रष्ट पुलिस के कारण विशाल के पिता आत्महत्या करने पर वह बदला लेता है।.

credits.actor: Sunny Deol,Raveena Tandon,Anupam Kher,Farida Jalal,Manisha Koirala,Deven Verma,Amrish Puri,Mohan Joshi

programme.title: Max und die Halbritter 4
Max and the Midknights: Time After Time
programme.sub-title: Immer und immer wieder
programme.desc: Im Turm der Zeit hilft Mumblin den Halbrittern, in die Vergangenheit zu reisen, um Torins Bösling aufzuhalten. Zuerst reisen sie zu dem Moment, den Max am meisten bereut: dem Augenblick, in dem sie zuließ, dass der Bösling das Amulett von Königin Nerelia stahl. Leider gelingt es Torin jedes Mal auf absurde und unerwartete Weise, das Amulett dennoch in die Hände zu bekommen, egal wie sehr die Halbritter versuchen, die Vergangenheit zu verändern. Daraufhin ändern die Halbritter ihren Plan und reisen zu dem Zeitpunkt zurück, an dem Torin den Spiegel und ganz Byjovia zerstörte. Diesmal haben sie mehr Erfolg. Max gelingt es, die Vergangenheit zu verändern, und die Halbritter können die Bewohner Byjovias aus der Schattenwelt retten und die Böslinge erfolgreich bekämpfen. Als es so aussieht, als stünde Torins Bösling kurz vor der endgültigen Niederlage, werden die Halbritter jedoch mit unerwarteten Folgen konfrontiert: Ein geheimnisvoller Junge aus der Zukunft namens Nate Wright taucht plötzlich in Byjovia auf.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 8
SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.sub-title: Der Weg des Schwamms
programme.desc: Aus Langeweile erfinden Patrick und SpongeBob die verschärften Seifenblasen aus scharfer Sauce. Deren Wirkung ist krass, aber amüsant, finden die beiden. Auch Sandy soll in den Genuss der verschärften Blasen kommen, doch die muss sich gerade um ihre verstopften Luftleitungen kümmern. SpongeBobs Idee, die Verstopfung mit scharfen Blasen zu beseitigen, führt leider zur Beseitigung sämtlicher Atemluft in Sandys Baumkuppel und, daraus resultierend, zu ernsthaften Problemen für das Eichhörnchen... // Sandy hat Besuch von ihrem Karatelehrer Fuzzy Acorns, bei dem sie die Prüfung für den noch schwärzeren Gürtel ablegen will. Auch SpongeBob hätte gerne einen Gürtel, doch der schnöselige Karatemeister befindet ihn nach einigen Tests als unwürdig. Sandy wiederum findet, Fuzzy habe vorschnell geurteilt, und nimmt den Meister mit in die Krosse Krabbe, um SpongeBob in voller Aktion zu erleben..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 4
SpongeBob SquarePants: Dunces And Dragons
programme.sub-title: Der edle Ritter
programme.desc: Nach einem Zusammenstoß finden sich SpongeBob und Patrick plötzlich in einer mittelalterlichen Version von Bikini Bottom wieder. Die Einwohner halten die beiden für ritterliche Recken und verpflichten sie prompt, eine Heldentat zu vollbringen: Sie sollen König Krabs' Tochter Perla aus der Gewalt des bösen Zauberers Planktonamor befreien. Als Helfer stellt der König ihnen seinen Hofnarren Thaddäus zur Verfügung, der wegen erwiesener Unwitzigkeit zu nichts anderem zu gebrauchen ist. Notgedrungen bricht das ungleiche Trio zur Festung des Oberschurken auf. Doch der Weg dorthin ist weit und voller Gefahren. Die größte Gefahr geht von dem Schwarzen Ritter aus, einem verdächtig bekannt aussehenden Eichhörnchen. Und auch Planktonamors Feuer speiende Riesenqualle ist ein äußerst fieser Zeitgenosse. Sir SpongeBob und seine Gefährten müssen sich schon besonders ins Zeug legen, um sämtliche Unholde zu besiegen und ihren Auftrag zu erfüllen..

programme.title: iCarly 4
iCarly: iLove You
programme.sub-title: Und zum Schluss ein Kuss
programme.desc: Warum wird Entertainment für Kinder bloß immer von Erwachsenen gemacht? Das fragt sich die 13-jährige Carly Shay (Miranda Cosgrove) - und beschließt eines Tages, zusammen mit ihren Freunden Samantha "Sam" Puckett (Jennette McCurdy) und Frederick "Freddie" Benson (Nathan Kress) eine eigene Internet-Show auf die Beine zu stellen. In 'iCarly', wie sie die Sendung taufen, fordern sie die Kinder zum Mitmachen auf: Mit Sketchen, seltsamen Rezepten oder bei Carlys Talentsuchen können sie beweisen, was in ihnen steckt. "iCarly" entwickelt sich zu einer Kultsendung, und Carly, Sam und Freddie werden im Netz zu richtigen Berühmtheiten. So müssen sie lernen, ihre alltäglichen Probleme mit ihrem plötzlichen Ruhm unter einen Hut zu bringen - und dabei auch noch jede Woche eine großartige Show abliefern. Wenn Carly gerade nicht vor der Kamera steht, greift sie ihrem älteren Bruder Spencer (Jerry Trainor) unter die Arme, bei dem sie auch wohnt, denn der etwas versponnene Künstler bringt sich durch seine Ungeschicklichkeit öfters mal in Schwierigkeiten.

In 'iCarly', wie sie die Sendung taufen, fordern sie die Kinder zum Mitmachen auf: Mit Sketchen, seltsamen Rezepten oder bei Carlys Talentsuchen können sie beweisen, was in ihnen steckt. "iCarly" entwickelt sich zu einer Kultsendung, und Carly, Sam und Freddie werden im Netz zu richtigen Berühmtheiten. So müssen sie lernen, ihre alltäglichen Probleme mit ihrem plötzlichen Ruhm unter einen Hut zu bringen - und dabei auch noch jede Woche eine großartige Show abliefern. Wenn Carly gerade nicht vor der Kamera steht, greift sie ihrem älteren Bruder Spencer (Jerry Trainor) unter die Arme, bei dem sie auch wohnt, denn der etwas versponnene Künstler bringt sich durch seine Ungeschicklichkeit öfters mal in Schwierigkeiten.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 11
SpongeBob SquarePants: Doodle Dimension / Moving Bubble Bass
programme.sub-title: In der Kritzelzone / Blubberbernd verzieht sich
programme.desc: SpongeBob Schwammkopf wohnt mit seiner Schnecke Gary in der Unterwasserstadt Bikini Bottom in einer Zwei-Zimmer-Ananas und arbeitet als Krabbenburgerbrater im Fastfood-Restaurant 'Krosse Krabbe', wo Mr. Krabs sein Chef ist. Neben dem Schwammkopf ist SpongeBobs Markenzeichen die eckige Quadrathose. Seine Freunde sind Tintenfisch Thaddäus, Eichhorn Sandy und Seestern Patrick. Sein Feind ist der fiese Plankton, der an das Geheimrezept der Krabbenburger und die Weltherrschaft gelangen will. Die Serie basiert auf wahren Begebenheiten. Nun, zumindest ist ihr Erfinder Stephen Hillenburg ausgebildeter Meeresbiologe, er müsste also wissen, wie es da unten zugeht.

programme.title: Schere, Stein, Papier 2
programme.sub-title: Schere ist ein ganz Lieber / Papiers Familientreffen
programme.desc: Stein will seinem Boss Franz Roll näherkommen und lädt ihn ein. Doch als Franz ankommt und Schere zum ersten Mal sieht, hält er ihn für einen Hund. Schere spielt die Illusion mit, da er in Franz' Villa ein komfortables Leben erwartet, wenn dieser ihn adoptiert. Franz und Schere kommen sich näher, was Stein frustriert, während er versucht, Franz zur Vernunft zu bringen. Papier wiederum versucht verzweifelt zu beweisen, dass er nicht langweilig ist. // Papier fürchtet das jährliche Familientreffen, da seine Familie extrem erfolgreich ist: seine Schwester Sandpapier ist Actionstar, sein Vater Backpapier ein berühmter Koch, seine Mutter Zeitungspapier eine bekannte Journalistin und sein Bruder Toilettenpapier ein weltberühmter Comedian. Um sich nicht erneut zu blamieren, plant Papier, sich selbst entführen zu lassen.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 16
SpongeBob SquarePants: SpongeBob TrashPants / Krusty Kafeteria
programme.sub-title: Der Müll-Entsorger / Die Krosse Cafeteria
programme.desc: SpongeBob macht sich an die Arbeit, in der Goo Lagune Müll aufzusammeln. Nachdem er alles geschafft hat, gibt es noch eine Müllkugel, die sich nicht einfangen lässt. Bei einer chaotischen Verfolgungsjagd wird der ganze Abfall über den Strand verteilt! Schuld war Plankton, der sich in der Kugel befand. Larry fordert von SpongeBob und Thaddäus, den Strand wieder zu säubern!//Perla verspricht ihren Klassenkameraden Krabbenburger, nachdem die strenge Küchenchefin Lenore sich verletzt hat. Mr. Krabs und SpongeBob fügen sich den Regeln der Cafeteria und befolgen Lenores Anweisungen, die externes Essen verbietet! SpongeBob und Mr. Krabs braten heimlich Krabbenburger, aber Lenore erwischt sie und eröffnet eine Essensschlacht! Dabei kostet sie einen Krabbenburger und er schmeckt ihr! Die Essensschlacht wird in der Krossen Krabbe fortgesetzt. Mr. Krabs ist begeistert - Je mehr Krabbenburger fliegen, desto mehr verdient er.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 2
SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.sub-title: Mundgeruch / Die Kuschel-Krabbe
programme.desc: SpongeBob macht sich aus den Resten in Kühl- und Speiseschrank ein Sonntagsfrühstück, das übelsten Mundgeruch hervorruft. Das merken alle außer ihm, und er wundert sich, warum alle Leute in Panik vor ihm davonrennen. Patrick vermutet, es liege daran, dass Sponge so hässlich sei. Das stürzt unseren Schwamm zwar in schwerste Depressionen, ändert aber nichts am Sachverhalt. Erst als auch Patrick von der Stinkmampfe kostet, merken die beiden, was eigentlich los ist... Mr. Krabs kündigt an, dass seine Tochter Perla während ihrer Sommerferien in der Krossen Krabbe arbeiten werde und auch eine Menge neuer Ideen habe. In der Tat, denn Perla verwandelt die Burger-Bude ruck-zuck und unter Einsatz erheblicher finanzieller Mittel in ein Jugendlokal, dass den schönen Namen "Kuschelkrabbe" trägt. Nun gibt es Salat statt Burger und die Angestellten werden gezwungen, ausnehmend alberne Uniformen zu tragen. Thaddäus macht das alles nicht lange mit, und sogar der langmütige SpongeBob hält es irgendwann nicht mehr aus. Er geht zu Mr. Krabs, dem im Verlauf des Gesprächs schnell klar wird, dass er Geld zum Fenster hinauswirft. Doch er traut sich nicht, seine Tochter zu feuern. Nun soll SpongeBob das übernehmen - und macht dabei eine überraschende Feststellung..

programme.desc: Suko erfährt, dass Aang erst nach dem Eintreffen des Kometen mit dem Feuerlord kämpfen will. Der Avatar fühlt sich dieser Herausforderung noch nicht gewachsen und möchte sich noch etwas mehr in Form bringen. Aber Suko will nicht warten und setzt Aang unter Druck. Dem wird alles zuviel und er flüchtet auf eine kleine Insel. Katara und ihrer Begleiter machen sich auf die Suche nach ihrem Freund, aber selbst June kann keine Fährte von ihm aufnehmen. Stattdessen führt sie die Reise zu Onkel Iroh. Aang treibt in der Zwischenzeit auf einer riesigen Löwenschildkröte durchs Meer.

programme.title: Avatar - Herr der Elemente 3
Avatar: The Last Airbender: Sozin's Comet, Part 4: Avatar Aang
programme.sub-title: Zosins Komet: Avatar Aang
programme.desc: Im Mittelpunkt von "Avatar - Der Herr der Elemente" steht der zwölfjährige Aang, der in einer von den Herren des Feuers beherrschten asiatischen Fantasy-Welt lebt. Aang ist nicht nur der letzte Herrscher über die Luft, sondern auch der Avatar, der Herr über alle Elemente. Er ist derjenige, der über die Form von Wasser, Erde, Luft und Feuer bestimmt. Doch der Avatar war 100 Jahre lang in einem Gletscher am Südpol eingefroren, und während dieser Zeit sind die Herrscher des Feuers ihrem Ziel der totalen Weltherrschaft immer näher gekommen. Erst als Aang von Katara, der letzten Gebieterin des Wassers, und deren Bruder Sokka aus dem ewigen Eis befreit wird, hat er eine Chance, seine Mission zu erfüllen: Er muss die aus den Fugen geratene Welt retten und die Balance der Elemente wiederherstellen. Eine große Herausforderung für einen Zwölfjährigen - schließlich muss er noch vieles lernen.

programme.title: Avatar - Herr der Elemente 2
Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Chase
programme.sub-title: Die Verfolgungsjagd
programme.desc: Aang und seine Freunde wollen gerade ihr Nachtlager aufschlagen, als sie bemerken, dass sie verfolgt werden. Schnell packen sie ihre Sachen zusammen und fliegen mit Appa weiter. Beim nächsten Rastplatz ergeht es ihnen genauso, und so fliehen sie die ganze Nacht hindurch vor einem unbekannten Feind. Schließlich erkennt der Avatar, dass ihnen eine Kampfmaschine aus Omashu auf den Fersen ist. Weil alle völlig übermüdet sind, kommt es zu einem heftigen Streit über das weitere Vorgehen. Wutentbrannt macht sich Toph allein davon. Aang, Katara und Sokka teilen sich auf, um die Maschine in die Irre zu führen. Doch die Feuerbändiger an Bord lassen sich so einfach nicht abschütteln - sie steigen aus und teilen sich ebenfalls auf. Jetzt scheint ein Kampf unvermeidlich..

programme.title: Avatar - Herr der Elemente
Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Boy in the Iceberg
programme.sub-title: Der Junge im Eisberg
programme.desc: Katara, die Herrscherin des Wassers, ist mit ihrem älteren Bruder Sokka unterwegs am Südpol. Dort ist ihre Heimat, die Heimat des Wasserstaates. Auf ihrer Reise entdecken sie einen gigantischen Eisberg. Doch damit nicht genug: In dem riesigen Brocken erblicken sie einen Jungen. Sein Name ist Aang - und wie Katara und Sokka später feststellen, ist Aang einer der Herrscher über die Luft. Doch die sind eigentlich ausgestorben, hieß es bislang. Zunächst müssen die Helden ihr Dorf retten, denn nach einer Reihe unglücklicher Ereignisse droht dort elementare Gefahr. Und jetzt erkennen Katara und Sokka, dass in dem Jungen aus dem Eisberg mehr steckt, als sie zunächst angenommen haben.
